summary.zh: 公元前342年，魏国进攻韩国，齐军以孙膑为军师出兵救援。孙膑用减灶之计示弱诱敌，在马陵道设伏，魏将庞涓追至马陵中伏自尽，魏太子申被俘后处死。此役使魏国丧失霸主地位，齐国成为东方强国，孙膑的用兵也成为中国古代军事谋略的经典案例。
summary.en: In 342 BCE Wei attacked Han and Qi sent troops to its aid under the strategist Sun Bin, who lured the Wei commander Pang Juan into a narrow defile at Maling by reducing his camp's cooking fires each day to feign desertion. The ambushed Wei army was destroyed, Pang Juan killed himself and Prince Shen was captured, ending Wei's supremacy.

significance.zh: 马陵之战终结了魏国的霸权，确立齐国东方强国的地位，孙膑的减灶诱敌也成为兵家典范。
significance.en: Maling ended Wei's hegemony, made Qi the leading eastern state and turned Sun Bin's decoy tactics into a classic of Chinese military thought.

sources.title: Wikidata — Q2005185（实体声明与坐标来源，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
Wikipedia — Battle of Maling（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 馬陵之戰（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 中文维基系于战国时期，英文维基给出公元前342年；维基数据P585记为ISO -341年，即民用纪年的公元前342年（本项目无0年）。
editorialNotes.en: English Wikipedia gives 342 BCE while Chinese Wikipedia dates the battle to the Warring States period; Wikidata P585 records ISO -341, which is 342 BCE in the civil convention used here.

summary.zh: 亚历山大率马其顿军队渡入亚洲，击败阿契美尼德帝国，随后远征至印度河流域。征服造成战争破坏，也建立了新的驻军、城市和统治网络。其死后，继承者分割帝国，各地希腊语文化与既有传统持续交融，形成通常称为希腊化时代的政治与文化格局。
summary.en: Alexander led Macedonian forces into Asia, defeated the Achaemenid Empire and campaigned as far as the Indus region. Conquest caused destruction while creating new garrisons, cities and networks of rule. After his death, successor rulers divided the empire, and interactions between Greek-speaking institutions and established local traditions shaped the political and cultural worlds of the Hellenistic period.

significance.zh: 重组了东地中海与西亚的政治联系和文化交流网络。
significance.en: Reorganised political connections and cultural exchange across the eastern Mediterranean and western Asia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Alexander’s campaigns into Asia

summary.zh: 公元前331年，亚历山大大帝率马其顿与希腊联军，在亚述地区的高加米拉附近与波斯帝国大流士三世的主力决战。亚历山大以斜线阵形突入波斯阵线中央，大流士逃离战场，波斯军队瓦解。此役终结了阿契美尼德王朝的军事力量，亚历山大随后占领巴比伦、苏萨与波斯波利斯。
summary.en: In 331 BCE Alexander the Great met the main army of Darius III of Persia near Gaugamela in Assyria. Alexander drove his cavalry into a gap in the Persian line, Darius fled and his army collapsed. The battle destroyed Achaemenid military power, and Alexander went on to take Babylon, Susa and Persepolis.

significance.zh: 高加米拉决定了阿契美尼德帝国的命运，为亚历山大征服波斯全境铺平道路。
significance.en: Gaugamela decided the fate of the Achaemenid empire and opened Alexander's conquest of Persia.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of Gaugamela（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 高加米拉戰役（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 维基数据记为公元前331年（ISO 8601 天文纪年为 -330），本项目民用纪年记为 -331；战场确切位置与波斯兵力数字仍有争议。
editorialNotes.en: Wikidata records 331 BCE (ISO 8601 year -330) and this project's civil count writes it as -331; the exact site and Persian numbers remain disputed.

summary.zh: 公元前330年冬，波斯总督阿里奥巴尔赞率军在波斯门隘口阻击亚历山大大帝的远征军。波斯军据险坚守约一个月，马其顿军正面难以突破，后由俘虏或当地牧人引路，绕至波斯军阵地后方夹击，隘口失守。此战后亚历山大得以深入波斯腹地并焚毁波斯波利斯。
summary.en: In the winter of 330 BC Ariobarzanes, satrap of Persis, held the Persian Gate against Alexander the Great's invading army for about a month. Guided by prisoners or a local shepherd, the Macedonians found a path around the position and attacked from the rear. The victory opened the Persian heartland; Persepolis was burned soon afterwards.

significance.zh: 波斯门是阿契美尼德帝国最后的正面抵抗之一，隘口失守后波斯本土再无屏障。
significance.en: The Persian Gate was one of the last stand-up defences of the Achaemenid Empire, and its fall left the Persian heartland open.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of the Persian Gate（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 波斯門戰役（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 古代史料的交战日期与兵力数字互相矛盾，战场确切位置也有争议；本条采用中文维基的公元前330年并只保留年份精度。
editorialNotes.en: Ancient sources disagree on the date and numbers and the exact site is debated; this entry follows 330 BC and keeps year precision.

summary.zh: 公元前326年，亚历山大大帝在旁遮普的希达斯皮斯河畔与波罗斯王交战。马其顿军队在暴雨夜渡河，避开战象正面，以骑兵包抄印军左翼，波罗斯兵败被俘。此役是亚历山大东征的最后一战；因士兵拒绝继续东进，他随后沿印度河南下返回波斯。
summary.en: In 326 BCE Alexander the Great fought King Porus on the Hydaspes river in the Punjab. The Macedonians crossed during a stormy night, avoided the elephants frontally and turned the Indian left with cavalry; Porus was defeated and captured. It was Alexander's last great battle: his troops refused to march further east and he turned back down the Indus.

significance.zh: 希达斯皮斯是亚历山大东征的终点，也展示了马其顿方阵面对战象时的战术调整。
significance.en: The Hydaspes marks the limit of Alexander's conquest and shows his tactics against war elephants.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of the Hydaspes（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 希達斯皮斯河戰役（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 维基数据记为公元前326年（ISO 8601 天文纪年为 -325），本项目民用纪年记为 -326；战场位置与波罗斯军队规模仍有争议。
editorialNotes.en: Wikidata records 326 BCE (ISO 8601 year -325), written here as -326; the battlefield and Porus's troop strength remain disputed.

summary.zh: 约前322年，旃陀罗笈多在北印度建立孔雀王朝，并逐渐扩展统治。以华氏城为中心的王权组织军队、官员和资源征收，连接恒河流域及更广阔的地区。继任统治者继续扩张，也面对如何治理不同地方社会的问题，使孔雀王朝成为南亚早期大型帝国的重要阶段。
summary.en: Around 322 BCE, Chandragupta established the Mauryan dynasty in northern India and began expanding its authority. From Pataliputra, rulers organised armies, officials and the collection of resources, linking the Ganges region with a much wider territory. Successors extended these connections while confronting the challenges of governing diverse local societies, creating a major early imperial formation in South Asia.

significance.zh: 推动南亚大范围政治整合与行政组织的发展。
significance.en: Advanced large-scale political integration and administrative organisation in South Asia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Rise of the Mauryan dynasty

editorialNotes.zh: 王朝建立年采用常用约数，不同历史重建对旃陀罗笈多的早期经历和年代有细节差异。
editorialNotes.en: The founding date is a common approximation; reconstructions differ in some details of Chandragupta’s early career and chronology.

title.zh: 欧几里得编纂《几何原本》

summary.zh: 约公元前300年，亚历山大里亚的欧几里得把前人积累的几何、比例和数论知识整理成《几何原本》。书中从定义、基本假设与共同概念出发，依次建立命题之间的证明关系。清晰的组织方式让它成为长期使用的教学经典，其严密论证的理想影响了后来多个语言世界中的数学研究。
summary.en: Around 300 BCE, Euclid in Alexandria organized inherited knowledge of geometry, proportion and number into the Elements. Beginning with definitions, postulates and common notions, the work arranged propositions into connected chains of proof. Its systematic exposition made it a durable teaching text, while its ideal of rigorous demonstration influenced mathematical study across later linguistic and intellectual traditions.

significance.zh: 《几何原本》使系统化证明成为数学教学与研究的重要范式。
significance.en: The Elements made systematic proof a lasting model for mathematical teaching and research.

sources.title: 圣安德鲁斯大学MacTutor数学史：Euclid

editorialNotes.zh: 欧几里得生平材料很少，约前300年是活动及编纂年代的常见估计。
editorialNotes.en: Evidence for Euclid's life is sparse; around 300 BCE is a conventional estimate for his activity and compilation.

summary.zh: 库施王国的政治重心逐渐转向麦罗埃，城市与周围地区发展出宫殿、神庙、金字塔墓地和手工业。铁器生产、农业及区域贸易支撑王权，麦罗埃文字也留下了自身的书写传统。位于尼罗河与非洲内陆联系地带的这一中心，持续吸收外来因素并形成独特的政治和艺术面貌。
summary.en: Kushite political activity increasingly centred on Meroe, where palaces, temples, pyramid cemeteries and craft production developed. Ironworking, agriculture and regional trade supported royal power, while the Meroitic script expressed a distinctive written tradition. Situated between Nile networks and inland African connections, the centre incorporated outside influences while developing its own political and artistic character.

significance.zh: 显示尼罗河上游国家在技术、贸易与文化创造中的持续活力。
significance.en: Shows the continuing vitality of upper Nile states in technology, trade and cultural production.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — The Kushite kingdom at Meroe

editorialNotes.zh: 所列区间选取麦罗埃作为重要王权中心的阶段；文字仍有大量内容无法充分解读。
editorialNotes.en: The interval selects Meroe’s importance as a royal centre; much of its written language remains incompletely understood.

title.zh: 阿努拉德普勒：佛教圣城的兴衰
title.en: Anuradhapura: rise and fall of a Buddhist sacred city

summary.zh: 约公元前3世纪起，阿努拉德普勒成为僧伽罗王国的都城与上座部佛教中心。佛塔、寺院与供水系统在城市周围扩展，僧团与王权互相支持，来自南亚与东南亚的朝圣者和商人往来其间。十世纪末，南印度朱罗军队攻占并破坏城市，政治中心随后东移，但寺院与朝圣传统延续下来。
summary.en: From about the third century BCE Anuradhapura served as the capital of Sinhalese kings and a centre of Theravada Buddhism. Stupas, monasteries and waterworks spread around the city as monastic institutions and royal power supported one another, while pilgrims and traders arrived from South and Southeast Asia. At the end of the tenth century a Chola army sacked the city and the political centre moved east.

significance.zh: 阿努拉德普勒体现了王权、僧团与水利社会在南亚的长期结合。
significance.en: Anuradhapura embodies the long alliance of royal power, monastic institutions and irrigation society in South Asia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Sacred City of Anuradhapura

editorialNotes.zh: 前3世纪为圣城传统的起点；993年是政治中心转移的事件年份，不代表佛教传统的终结。
editorialNotes.en: The third century BCE marks the beginning of the sacred-city tradition; 993 is a political event year, not the end of Buddhist practice.

title.zh: 阿育王的羯陵伽战争与法敕

summary.zh: 孔雀王朝的阿育王在羯陵伽战争后，通过岩石和石柱铭文宣示自己对统治责任的理解。敕令讨论减少伤害、善待臣民、尊重不同宗教群体等问题，也记录帝国官员和传播命令的方式。王室对佛教的支持扩大了其影响，战争经历与道德治理之间的张力成为阿育王历史形象的重要部分。
summary.en: After the Kalinga war, the Mauryan ruler Ashoka used inscriptions on rocks and pillars to explain his understanding of royal responsibility. The edicts discuss reducing harm, caring for subjects and respecting different religious communities, while revealing how imperial officials communicated authority. Royal support strengthened Buddhism, and the tension between conquest and ethical government became central to Ashoka’s historical legacy.

significance.zh: 留下了古代统治者公开阐述道德治理的珍贵铭文。
significance.en: Preserves exceptional inscriptions in which an ancient ruler publicly articulated ethical government.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Ashoka’s Kalinga war and edicts

editorialNotes.zh: 羯陵伽战争及早期法敕使用约年代；敕令中的统治者自我描述需要与其他史料共同阅读。
editorialNotes.en: The Kalinga war and early edicts use approximate dates; the ruler’s self-presentation should be read alongside other historical evidence.

summary.zh: 前221年，秦完成对六国的征服，秦王政采用皇帝称号，并将大片地区纳入郡县行政。统一后的度量衡、文字规范和交通建设加强了治理与资源调动，沉重徭役和强制政策也加剧社会压力。秦朝虽很快覆亡，其制度实践却深刻影响了后来的汉代及中国帝国政治。
summary.en: In 221 BCE, Qin completed its conquest of the rival states, and King Zheng adopted the title of emperor. Commandery and county administration, standardisation and transport projects strengthened government and resource mobilisation across a large territory. Heavy labour demands and coercive policies also generated pressure. Although the dynasty fell quickly, its institutions profoundly influenced Han and later imperial government.

significance.zh: 确立了此后帝国治理反复继承与调整的一套制度框架。
significance.en: Established an institutional framework repeatedly inherited and modified by later imperial governments.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Qin unification and imperial institutions

summary.zh: 第二次布匿战争中，汉尼拔率军进入意大利，在多场战役中重创罗马。罗马则依靠联盟、兵员和持续作战能力稳住局势，并将攻势扩展到伊比利亚与北非。前202年扎马战役后，迦太基接受严厉条件，罗马在西地中海的优势得到巩固，战争也给沿途社会带来长期损失。
summary.en: During the Second Punic War, Hannibal invaded Italy and inflicted major defeats on Roman armies. Rome sustained its position through alliances, manpower and continued mobilisation, while extending operations into Iberia and North Africa. Following Zama in 202 BCE, Carthage accepted severe terms, consolidating Roman predominance in the western Mediterranean after years of disruption and loss across affected societies.

significance.zh: 改变了西地中海的力量对比，并加速罗马的海外扩张。
significance.en: Changed the western Mediterranean balance of power and accelerated Roman overseas expansion.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Second Punic War

summary.zh: 公元前217年6月22日，托勒密四世与塞琉古国王安条克三世在加沙附近的拉菲亚决战，这是第四次叙利亚战争的决定性一役。托勒密军以新征召的埃及本土兵加强方阵，击退塞琉古一侧并迫使安条克退兵，科艾莱叙利亚重归托勒密治下，埃及本土兵的地位也随之上升。
summary.en: On 22 June 217 BC Ptolemy IV Philopator and Antiochus III of the Seleucid Empire fought at Raphia near Gaza in the decisive battle of the Fourth Syrian War. Ptolemy's phalanx, reinforced by newly recruited Egyptian troops, broke the Seleucid line and forced Antiochus to withdraw, returning Coele-Syria to Ptolemaic rule.

significance.zh: 拉菲亚是希腊化世界规模最大的会战之一，托勒密首次大规模武装埃及本土兵，也改变了埃及内部的力量格局。
significance.en: Raphia was among the largest battles of the Hellenistic world, and Ptolemy's mass recruitment of native Egyptians shifted the balance inside Egypt.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of Raphia（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 拉菲亞戰役（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 双方兵力数字出自古代作家且互相矛盾，战果统计也不可靠；本条只保留年份精度。
editorialNotes.en: The army sizes come from ancient authors and conflict with one another, as do the casualty figures; this entry keeps year precision.

summary.zh: 公元前207年，项羽率楚军在巨鹿（今河北平乡一带）与秦将章邯、王离所部主力决战。项羽破釜沉舟，先断秦军粮道，再会同诸侯军围歼王离部，章邯八个月后率二十万秦军投降。此役摧毁秦朝赖以立国的主力军团，项羽由此成为各路反秦义军的领袖。
summary.en: In 207 BCE Xiang Yu led the Chu army against the main Qin forces of Zhang Han and Wang Li at Julu. After burning his boats and breaking his pots to commit his troops, Xiang Yu cut the Qin supply lines and destroyed Wang Li's army; Zhang Han surrendered eight months later, deciding the fall of the Qin.

significance.zh: 巨鹿之战摧毁了秦朝的主力军团，项羽由此成为反秦义军领袖，秦朝的灭亡自此不可逆转。
significance.en: Julu destroyed the Qin field armies and made Xiang Yu the leader of the rebellion, making the dynasty's fall irreversible.

sources.title: Wikidata — Q3270429（实体声明与坐标来源，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
Wikipedia — Battle of Julu（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 巨鹿之战（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 中文维基与英文维基均系于公元前207年；维基数据P585记为ISO -206年，即民用纪年的公元前207年。
editorialNotes.en: Both Wikipedia articles give 207 BCE; Wikidata P585 records ISO -206, which is 207 BCE in the civil convention used here.

summary.zh: 公元前205年4月，楚汉战争期间，刘邦乘项羽北上攻齐之机，率五诸侯联军攻占楚都彭城。项羽闻讯后率三万精兵回师，清晨自萧县侧击联军，半日之内将数十万汉军击溃，睢水为之不流。刘邦仅以身免，其父与妻被楚军俘获，诸侯纷纷背汉归楚。
summary.en: In April 205 BCE Liu Bang took the Chu capital Pengcheng with a large coalition while Xiang Yu was campaigning in Qi. Xiang Yu returned with thirty thousand picked troops, fell on the allied camp at dawn and routed the far larger Han army in half a day; Liu Bang escaped alone and several allies defected to Chu.

significance.zh: 彭城之战是中国古代以少胜多的著名战例，楚汉战争的战略主动权一度重回项羽之手。
significance.en: Pengcheng is a famous Chinese victory against overwhelming odds and briefly returned the strategic initiative to Xiang Yu.

sources.title: Wikidata — Q847402（实体声明与坐标来源，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
Wikipedia — Battle of Pengcheng（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 彭城之戰（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 中英文维基与维基数据均系于公元前205年；维基数据P585记为ISO -204年，本项目民用纪年无0年，本条只保留年份精度。
editorialNotes.en: Both Wikipedia articles and Wikidata give 205 BCE; P585 records ISO -204 because the civil convention used here has no year zero, and the entry keeps year precision.

summary.zh: 刘邦在秦末战争和楚汉竞争中胜出，于前202年建立汉朝。新政权在继承秦代行政经验的同时调整统治方式，逐渐处理诸侯王、地方官员与中央之间的关系。农业恢复、财政组织和后续边疆经营支撑了长期统治，汉代的政治制度与文化传统由此展开。
summary.en: After warfare following Qin’s collapse and the struggle with Xiang Yu, Liu Bang established the Han dynasty in 202 BCE. The new regime adapted Qin administrative practices while renegotiating relations among the court, regional kings and local officials. Agricultural recovery, fiscal organisation and later frontier policies supported a long period of rule and the development of influential political and cultural traditions.

significance.zh: 开启了对中国制度、文化与欧亚联系影响深远的王朝时代。
significance.en: Opened a dynastic era with lasting effects on Chinese institutions, culture and Eurasian connections.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Foundation of the Han dynasty

summary.zh: 公元前202年，刘邦与韩信等诸侯联军在垓下（今安徽境内）包围项羽的楚军。汉军夜唱楚歌动摇楚军士气，项羽率八百骑突围南走，最终在乌江边自刎。此战是中国古代著名的围歼战例，汉军以绝对优势完成合围。楚汉战争至此结束，刘邦称帝建立汉朝。
summary.en: In 202 BC the allied forces of Liu Bang and Han Xin surrounded Xiang Yu's Chu army at Gaixia in Anhui. Songs from Chu sung at night broke the besieged army's morale; Xiang Yu escaped south with 800 riders and finally took his own life by the Wu River. The Chu-Han contention ended and Liu Bang founded the Han dynasty.

significance.zh: 垓下之战终结了楚汉相争，直接决定了汉朝四百年统治的开端。
significance.en: Gaixia ended the Chu-Han war and opened four centuries of Han rule.

title.zh: 纳斯卡地画与沙漠社会

summary.zh: 秘鲁南部干旱地区的纳斯卡人移开深色地表石块，形成动物、植物和几何形状的巨大地画。沙漠环境让这些痕迹长期保存，相关道路、聚落和礼仪遗存则显示地画与社会活动的联系。居民还发展出适应缺水环境的生产方式，使艺术、信仰和环境管理共同塑造了这片景观。
summary.en: People in the Nazca region of southern Peru removed dark surface stones to create enormous animal, plant and geometric designs. Arid conditions preserved these traces, while associated paths, settlements and ritual remains connect the geoglyphs with social activity. Communities also developed ways of living with limited water, bringing artistic expression, belief and environmental management together in a distinctive landscape.

significance.zh: 保存了安第斯社会将仪式活动融入自然环境的独特证据。
significance.en: Preserves distinctive evidence of how Andean communities incorporated ritual into their environment.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Nazca geoglyphs and desert societies

editorialNotes.zh: 地画的具体功能、建造阶段和使用者关系仍有多种解释，所列年代涵盖一个宽泛发展阶段。
editorialNotes.en: The functions, construction phases and users of the geoglyphs remain subjects of differing interpretations; the dates span a broad development phase.

title.zh: 骠国城市与灌溉社会发展
title.en: Pyu cities and irrigated urban society

summary.zh: 公元前后，伊洛瓦底江流域的骠人逐渐建起带城墙和护城河的城市。室利差呾罗等中心通过蓄水与灌溉支持农业，城内出现宫殿、佛塔和手工业作坊。居民吸收南亚的宗教与文字传统，又在本地社会中重新塑造它们，城市之间及其与印度、中国的贸易联系随之扩大。
summary.en: Around the beginning of the Common Era, Pyu communities in the Ayeyarwady basin developed cities enclosed by walls and moats. Centres such as Sri Ksetra supported agriculture through water storage and irrigation, alongside palaces, Buddhist monuments and workshops. Residents adapted South Asian religious and written traditions while maintaining exchanges with other Southeast Asian communities, India and China.

significance.zh: 农业水利、城市组织和跨区域交流共同推动了缅甸早期城市社会的发展。
significance.en: Irrigation, urban organization and long-distance exchange together sustained early cities in Myanmar.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：骠国古城

title.zh: 丝绸之路廊道上的跨洲交换
title.en: Transcontinental exchange along the Silk Roads corridor

summary.zh: 公元前二世纪以后，连接长安与中亚绿洲的交通线持续扩展，商队、使者与僧侣沿塔里木盆地南北两道往来。丝绸、马匹、玻璃、香料与纸张在绿洲城市间转手，佛教、摩尼教与伊斯兰教也随商路传播。十四世纪前后海上贸易与政治变动改变了陆路格局，但廊道上的城市与知识网络并未立即消失。
summary.en: After the second century BCE the routes linking Chang'an with Central Asian oases expanded, carrying caravans, envoys and monks along the northern and southern edges of the Tarim basin. Silk, horses, glass, aromatics and paper changed hands in oasis cities, while Buddhism, Manichaeism and Islam spread along the same roads. Maritime trade and political change later reshaped these networks without ending them at once.

significance.zh: 这条廊道说明欧亚大陆的贸易、宗教与知识交流长期依赖同一套绿洲城市网络。
significance.en: The corridor shows how trade, religion and knowledge in Eurasia depended on one network of oasis cities.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Silk Roads: the Routes Network of Chang'an–Tianshan Corridor

editorialNotes.zh: 本条描述廊道网络的长期运行，不主张某条路线的精确走向，也不把商路视为由单一政权全程管理。
editorialNotes.en: This entry describes the long-running network rather than an exact route alignment, and does not treat the routes as administered by a single power throughout.

title.en: Zhang Qian’s missions and Eurasian connections

summary.zh: 汉武帝派张骞出使西域，寻求与月氏等势力的联系。他在长期滞留与行旅后返回汉廷，带回关于中亚地区政治、物产和道路的信息。此后汉朝的军事、外交和贸易活动进一步向西展开，使原有的欧亚交换网络获得新的联系，也让不同地区的知识与商品更加频繁地流动。
summary.en: Emperor Wu sent Zhang Qian westward to seek contacts with the Yuezhi and other powers. After prolonged captivity and travel, he returned with information about Central Asian politics, products and routes. Subsequent Han diplomacy, military activity and trade extended these connections, adding to existing Eurasian networks through which knowledge, people and goods circulated with growing frequency.

significance.zh: 扩展了汉朝对中亚的认识及其参与欧亚交流的范围。
significance.en: Expanded Han knowledge of Central Asia and its participation in Eurasian exchange.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Zhang Qian’s missions and Eurasian connections

summary.zh: 公元前133年，汉武帝采纳王恢之议，以聂壹为内应，诱匈奴军臣单于进入马邑设伏围歼。单于行至途中察觉有诈，引兵而退，伏击落空。此谋虽未交战，却结束了汉朝对匈奴六十余年的和亲政策，拉开汉匈全面战争的序幕，也促使汉廷转向主动出击的骑兵战略。
summary.en: In 133 BCE the Han court under Emperor Wu tried to ambush the Xiongnu chanyu Junchen at Mayi, using the merchant Nie Yi as a decoy. The chanyu suspected the trap and withdrew before the Han armies could close it. No fighting took place, but the scheme ended six decades of heqin appeasement and opened the Han-Xiongnu wars.

significance.zh: 马邑之谋虽未成功，却终结了汉匈和亲，标志汉朝对匈奴战略由守势转向全面战争。
significance.en: The aborted Mayi ambush ended the heqin peace and marked the Han shift from appeasement to open war against the Xiongnu.

summary.zh: 公元前105年10月6日，罗马两支军队在阿劳西奥（今法国奥朗日）与罗讷河之间迎战辛布里人与条顿人。执政官马克西姆斯与前执政官卡埃皮奥互不信任、各自为战，被对方先后击破，罗马损失据称达八万人以上，是共和国史上最惨重的败仗之一。
summary.en: On 6 October 105 BC two Roman armies faced the migrating Cimbri and Teutones between Arausio, modern Orange, and the Rhone. Consul Gnaeus Mallius Maximus and proconsul Quintus Servilius Caepio refused to cooperate and were destroyed one after the other; losses are put at 80,000 or more, among Rome's worst defeats.

significance.zh: 阿劳西奥的惨败直接促成马略的军事改革与连续执政，改变了罗马共和国的兵制与政治。
significance.en: The disaster at Arausio led directly to the Marian military reforms and to Marius holding consecutive consulships.

title.zh: 佛教沿丝绸之路的传播
title.en: Buddhism travels along the Silk Roads

summary.zh: 公元前后的数百年间，佛教从印度经中亚绿洲传入塔里木盆地与中国内地，僧侣、商队与使团沿同一路线往返。译经活动把梵文与中亚语言文本转写为汉文，寺院在绿洲城市和交通节点建立，犍陀罗与敦煌等地形成融合多种艺术传统的造像与壁画。八世纪以后陆路佛教社群在部分地区衰落，但网络遗产延续至今。
summary.en: In the centuries around the beginning of the common era, Buddhism travelled from India through Central Asian oases into the Tarim basin and China, carried by monks, merchants and envoys. Translation projects rendered Sanskrit and Central Asian texts into Chinese, monasteries grew at oasis towns, and Gandhara and Dunhuang developed hybrid sculptural and mural traditions.

significance.zh: 佛教的陆路传播说明宗教、贸易与翻译网络在欧亚大陆相互交织。
significance.en: The overland spread of Buddhism shows how religious, commercial and translation networks intertwined across Eurasia.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Buddhism along the Silk Road

editorialNotes.zh: 传播并非单向或均质，各地接受的时间与形式差异很大，本条只用世纪尺度表述。
editorialNotes.en: Transmission was neither one-way nor uniform; the entry therefore uses century-scale phrasing.

summary.zh: 公元前46年，凯撒在北非塔普苏斯附近击败庞培派元老军，努米底亚国王朱巴一世与梅特卢斯·西庇阿的联军随之瓦解。小加图在乌提卡自杀，北非的反凯撒势力被清除。此役为凯撒回罗马后连续担任独裁官、推行改革扫清了军事障碍，他随后被任命为为期十年的独裁官。
summary.en: In 46 BCE Caesar defeated the Pompeian senatorial army near Thapsus in North Africa, and the allied forces of King Juba I of Numidia and Metellus Scipio broke up. Cato the Younger took his own life at Utica and opposition to Caesar in Africa ended. The victory cleared the way for Caesar's successive dictatorships and reforms in Rome.

significance.zh: 塔普苏斯清除了北非的共和派力量，为凯撒的独裁与罗马共和国的终结铺路。
significance.en: Thapsus destroyed the republican forces in Africa and prepared Caesar's dictatorship and the end of the Republic.

维基百科 — 薩普蘇斯戰役（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.en: Wikidata records 46 BCE (ISO 8601 year -45), written here as -46; sources convert the battle date to either 6 February or 6 April 46 BCE.

summary.zh: 公元前46年1月4日，凯撒率军在阿非利加行省的鲁斯皮纳（今突尼斯境内）附近遭拉比埃努斯指挥的贵族派军队突袭。对方以努米底亚骑兵与轻步兵包围凯撒的阵列，凯撒军伤亡严重但未崩溃，最终退回鲁斯皮纳。此后凯撒在塔普苏斯才取得决定性胜利。
summary.en: On 4 January 46 BC Caesar's army was surprised near Ruspina in the province of Africa by the Republican force of Titus Labienus, his former lieutenant. Numidian cavalry and light infantry enveloped the Caesarian line, which suffered heavily but held together and withdrew to Ruspina. Caesar won decisively only later at Thapsus.

significance.zh: 鲁斯皮纳显示贵族派在阿非利加仍有强大骑兵优势，是凯撒北非战役中最危险的一战。
significance.en: Ruspina showed the Republicans' continuing cavalry superiority in Africa and was the closest Caesar came to defeat there.

editorialNotes.en: Caesar's own account of the casualties is self-justifying and the losses on both sides cannot be verified; this entry keeps year precision.

title.zh: 奥古斯都与罗马元首制

summary.zh: 前27年，屋大维获得奥古斯都称号，在内战之后建立以个人权威为核心的新政治秩序。他保留共和国的许多官职与形式，同时控制关键军队、省份和资源。元首制使罗马统治获得较长时期的稳定，也将政治权力与皇室继承问题紧密结合，改变了地中海世界的治理方式。
summary.en: In 27 BCE, Octavian received the title Augustus and consolidated a new political order after civil war. Republican offices and procedures continued, while decisive control over armies, provinces and resources centred on one ruler. The principate brought greater stability to Roman rule but also tied political authority to questions of imperial succession, transforming government across the Mediterranean world.

significance.zh: 奠定了罗马帝国元首制的政治基础。
significance.en: Established the political foundations of the Roman imperial principate.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Augustus and the Roman Principate

summary.zh: 公元初的印度洋航海者利用季风往返红海、阿拉伯半岛、东非和南亚港口。香料、织物、象牙及贵金属通过多种商人和地方市场流通，港口社会也在语言、信仰和生活方式上相互影响。海上航行与陆地运输相接，使广阔海域逐渐成为联系多个经济中心的交换空间。
summary.en: In the early centuries CE, Indian Ocean sailors used the monsoons to travel among ports in the Red Sea, Arabia, eastern Africa and South Asia. Spices, textiles, ivory and precious metals passed through diverse merchants and local markets. Maritime voyages joined overland transport, while port communities exchanged languages, beliefs and practices across an increasingly connected commercial world.

significance.zh: 展示季风知识与港口网络如何支撑跨区域贸易。
significance.en: Shows how knowledge of the monsoons and networks of ports sustained interregional trade.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Indian Ocean monsoon trading networks

title.zh: 霍普韦尔仪式土方工程兴盛

summary.zh: 公元最初四个世纪，俄亥俄河支流流域的社群定期聚集，修筑规模宏大的圆形、方形和八角形土垒。精确的几何布局与日月运行周期相联系，显示长期观察和工程知识的积累。来自远方的原料被制成精美仪式器物，说明这些以耕种、采集和捕鱼维生的社群参与了广泛交流。
summary.en: During the first four centuries CE, communities along tributaries of the Ohio River gathered to build enormous circular, square and octagonal earthworks. Precise layouts related to solar and lunar cycles reflect sustained observation and engineering knowledge. Fine ceremonial objects used materials obtained from distant places, showing extensive connections among communities supported by cultivation, gathering and fishing.

significance.zh: 霍普韦尔遗址把天文观察、几何规划与跨区域社会交往结合在一起。
significance.en: Hopewell earthworks unite astronomical observation, geometric design and interregional social connections.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：霍普韦尔仪式土方工程

title.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎的都市繁荣

summary.zh: 特奥蒂瓦坎在墨西哥高原成长为大型都市，居民沿规划道路生活，修筑金字塔、广场和多家庭住宅区。专业工匠制作黑曜石制品、陶器等物品，城市与周围地区保持广泛交换。来自不同背景的人群共同塑造了都市生活，其建筑和文化影响远及中美洲其他地区。
summary.en: Teotihuacan grew into a major city in the Mexican highlands, with planned streets, pyramids, plazas and multifamily residential compounds. Specialised craftspeople produced obsidian objects, pottery and other goods exchanged through extensive regional connections. Residents of different backgrounds shaped its urban life, while the city’s architecture and cultural influence reached many other parts of Mesoamerica.

significance.zh: 成为研究美洲古代都市规模、多样性与区域联系的重要案例。
significance.en: Provides a major case for studying the scale, diversity and regional connections of ancient American cities.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Urban flourishing at Teotihuacan

editorialNotes.zh: 统治者身份、政治组织和衰落过程仍存在讨论，主要发展阶段的边界为约数。
editorialNotes.en: The identities of rulers, political organisation and processes of decline remain debated; the boundaries of the principal development phase are approximate.

summary.zh: 公元9年，日耳曼首领阿尔米尼乌斯在条顿堡森林伏击普布利乌斯·昆克提利乌斯·瓦鲁斯率领的三个罗马军团。罗马军队在泥泞林地中无法列阵，几乎全军覆没，瓦鲁斯自杀。此役使罗马放弃了征服莱茵河以东日耳曼尼亚的计划，莱茵河与多瑙河一线成为帝国北方的长期边界。
summary.en: In 9 CE the Germanic leader Arminius ambushed three Roman legions under Publius Quinctilius Varus in the Teutoburg Forest. Unable to deploy in wooded, marshy ground, the Roman force was destroyed and Varus took his own life. Rome abandoned the conquest of Germania beyond the Rhine, which became the empire's long northern frontier.

significance.zh: 条顿堡森林战役终结了罗马对莱茵河以东日耳曼尼亚的征服计划。
significance.en: The Teutoburg Forest ended Roman plans to conquer Germania beyond the Rhine.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of the Teutoburg Forest（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 條頓堡森林之戰（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 战场位置长期未定，多数研究者倾向于下萨克森地区的卡尔克里泽，本条沿用维基数据坐标并保留公元9年的年份精度。
editorialNotes.en: The battlefield was long unidentified and most researchers favour Kalkriese in Lower Saxony; this entry keeps the Wikidata coordinate and year precision.

summary.zh: 公元23年6月至7月，绿林军建立的更始政权在昆阳（今河南叶县）以少胜多，击破王莽新朝主力。刘秀率数千援军突入敌阵，新军主帅王寻被杀，大军溃散。此役摧毁了新朝赖以支撑的军事力量，同年绿林军攻入长安，新莽覆亡，刘秀日后建立东汉。
summary.en: In June and July of 23 CE the Lulin army of the Gengshi regime, outnumbered many times over, broke the main Xin dynasty force at Kunyang in present-day Henan. Liu Xiu led a small relief column into the enemy camp, Wang Xun was killed and the Xin army collapsed; the defeat destroyed the dynasty's military power.

significance.zh: 昆阳之战是中国古代以少胜多的著名战例，直接导致新莽王朝覆灭，刘秀由此崛起。
significance.en: Kunyang is a classic Chinese example of victory against overwhelming odds; it destroyed the Xin dynasty and launched Liu Xiu's rise.

sources.title: Wikidata — Q3272217（实体声明与坐标来源，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.en: Both Wikipedia articles date the battle to June and July of 23 CE; the entry keeps year precision.

title.zh: 耶稣活动与基督教起源
title.en: Jesus and the origins of Christianity

summary.zh: 耶稣在罗马统治下的犹太地区开展教导，吸引追随者，并最终在耶路撒冷被处死。门徒围绕他的生活、死亡与复活信仰形成社群，通过传教、书信和聚会扩展联系。早期基督教在犹太传统与罗马地中海社会中发展，逐渐形成自己的经文、礼仪和组织方式。
summary.en: Jesus taught in Judaea under Roman rule, gathered followers and was eventually executed in Jerusalem. His disciples formed communities around accounts of his life and death and their belief in his resurrection, spreading connections through preaching, letters and gatherings. Early Christianity developed within Jewish traditions and the Roman Mediterranean, gradually establishing its scriptures, rituals and forms of organisation.

significance.zh: 开启了后来广泛传播的基督教社群与思想传统。
significance.en: Began the communities and intellectual traditions from which Christianity spread widely.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Jesus and the origins of Christianity

editorialNotes.zh: 处刑年代通常估计在公元30年前后，也有公元33年等方案；宗教信仰内容与可考历史叙述的证据性质不同。
editorialNotes.en: The execution is commonly dated around 30 CE, with 33 CE among other proposals. Religious beliefs and historical reconstructions rest on different kinds of evidence.

summary.zh: 公元40年，征侧与征贰领导反抗东汉统治的起义，获得今越南北部多地支持，并建立短暂的独立政权。汉军随后南下，至43年镇压起义并加强地方控制。征氏姐妹的故事在后世被持续纪念，成为越南历史记忆中地方自主、反抗统治与女性领导力的重要象征。
summary.en: In 40 CE, Trưng Trắc and Trưng Nhị led an uprising against Eastern Han rule, gaining support across parts of present-day northern Vietnam and establishing a short-lived independent government. Han forces suppressed the revolt by 43 and strengthened their control. Later commemoration made the sisters enduring figures of autonomy, resistance and women’s leadership in Vietnamese historical memory.

significance.zh: 留下了越南早期政治反抗与女性领导的重要历史记忆。
significance.en: Created an enduring historical memory of early Vietnamese resistance and women’s leadership.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Trưng sisters’ uprising

summary.zh: 公元43年，梅德韦战役位于坐标 51.440°N、0.742°E 附近。属于罗马征服不列颠的组成部分。交战方为古罗马、格奈烏斯•霍西迪烏斯•蓋塔、多哥杜姆努斯、提圖斯•弗拉維烏斯•薩比努斯。结构化索引条目，取自维基数据 Q617650 声明，未经独立史料考订。
summary.en: Battle of the Medway took place in 43 CE near coordinates 51.440°N, 0.742°E. Part of Roman conquest of Britain. Belligerents recorded: Galba, Vespasian, Caratacus, Aulus Plautius, Titus Flavius Sabinus. This is a structured index entry: names, dates, coordinates and participants come directly from Wikidata entity Q617650 statements and have not been independently verified against scholarship by this project.

significance.en: Records a military event during Roman conquest of Britain for chronological and geographic orientation.

summary.zh: 公元69年四帝之年，贝德里亚库姆（今意大利卡尔瓦托内附近）先后发生两场会战。4月，维提里乌斯的莱茵军团击败皇帝奥托的军队，奥托自杀；10月，拥护维斯帕先的东方军团在同一地区击败维提里乌斯派，维提里乌斯被杀，弗拉维王朝由此建立。
summary.en: In AD 69, the Year of the Four Emperors, two battles were fought near Bedriacum in northern Italy. In April Vitellius's Rhine legions defeated the army of the emperor Otho, who killed himself; in October the eastern legions supporting Vespasian beat the Vitellian forces and Vitellius was killed, beginning the Flavian dynasty.

significance.zh: 贝德里亚库姆的两场会战决定了四帝之年的结局，也确立了军团推举皇帝的权力格局。
significance.en: The two battles at Bedriacum decided the Year of the Four Emperors and confirmed the legions' power to make emperors.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of Bedriacum（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 貝德里亞庫姆戰役（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 两场会战实际发生在贝德里亚库姆与克雷莫纳之间，故又称第一次与第二次克雷莫纳之战，年份同为69年；本条只保留年份精度。
editorialNotes.en: Both battles were fought between Bedriacum and Cremona and are also called the first and second battles of Cremona, both in AD 69; this entry keeps year precision.

summary.zh: 公元79年，维苏威火山猛烈喷发，火山灰、碎屑与高温流动掩埋庞贝、赫库兰尼姆及周边聚落。灾难夺去众多生命，也封存了房屋、商铺、壁画和日常用品。后来发掘的遗迹让研究者能够细察罗马城市中的居住、劳动、消费与社会差异，使一次灾难留下了罕见的生活记录。
summary.en: In 79 CE, Vesuvius erupted violently, burying Pompeii, Herculaneum and nearby settlements beneath ash, debris and hot flows. Many people died, while houses, shops, paintings and everyday objects were sealed beneath the deposits. Later excavations created an unusually detailed record of housing, work, consumption and social differences within Roman urban life.

significance.zh: 让古代自然灾害与罗马城市日常生活获得了罕见的实物记录。
significance.en: Preserved exceptional material evidence of an ancient disaster and everyday Roman urban life.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Eruption of Mount Vesuvius

editorialNotes.zh: 喷发发生在79年，但具体月份和日期仍因文献抄本与考古材料而有讨论。
editorialNotes.en: The eruption occurred in 79 CE, but its precise month and date remain debated in light of manuscript and archaeological evidence.

title.zh: 罗马斗兽场落成与公共娱乐
title.en: Inauguration of the Colosseum and Roman public entertainment

summary.zh: 公元80年，提图斯为罗马斗兽场举行落成活动。这座由弗拉维王朝修建的圆形竞技场可容纳数万观众，用于角斗、狩猎表演与公开处决。竞技活动与皇帝、元老和民众之间的政治关系相连，也依赖帝国各地提供的物资与人力。斗兽场在后世被反复使用和拆解，其外壳仍是最具辨识度的罗马建筑之一。
summary.en: In 80 CE Titus inaugurated the Colosseum, the Flavian amphitheatre built for tens of thousands of spectators, where gladiatorial contests, hunts and executions took place. The shows were bound up with political relations among emperor, senate and people and depended on supplies and manpower drawn from across the empire. Later reuse and stone robbing left the arena's shell.

significance.zh: 斗兽场把罗马的公共娱乐、皇权展示与帝国资源动员集中在一座建筑之中。
significance.en: The Colosseum concentrated Roman public entertainment, imperial display and resource mobilisation in one building.

sources.title: Parco archeologico del Colosseo — Blood and the Arena

editorialNotes.zh: 80年为落成活动之年，建筑在弗拉维王朝期间分期完成；后世使用与拆解持续到中世纪以后。
editorialNotes.en: 80 CE is the inauguration year; the building was completed in stages under the Flavians, and later reuse and stone removal continued for centuries.

summary.zh: 公元83年，罗马将领阿格里科拉率军在苏格兰东北部的格劳庇乌山击败喀里多尼亚部落联军。塔西佗在《阿格里科拉传》中记下了双方战前演说与悬殊的伤亡数字。罗马此后再未深入苏格兰高地，公元二世纪起以哈德良长城与安东尼长城为北方边界。
summary.en: In 83 CE the Roman governor Agricola defeated a Caledonian tribal army at Mons Graupius in north-eastern Scotland. Tacitus, in the Agricola, records speeches before the battle and heavily one-sided casualty figures. Rome did not campaign that far north again, and from the second century the frontier ran along Hadrian's and the Antonine walls.

significance.zh: 格劳庇乌山是罗马在不列颠最北的大规模会战，其记载主要依赖塔西佗一家之言。
significance.en: Mons Graupius was Rome's northernmost large battle in Britain and is known mainly from Tacitus alone.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of Mons Graupius（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 格劳庇乌山战役（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 战场位置至今未定，兵力与伤亡数字来自塔西佗的单方面记载，本条保留83年的年份精度。
editorialNotes.en: The battlefield is unidentified and the numbers come only from Tacitus; this entry keeps year precision.

title.zh: 贵霜时代的跨区域交流

summary.zh: 贵霜王朝控制了中亚与南亚之间的重要地区，城市、商路和钱币流通将不同人群联系起来。佛教寺院与艺术活动在王室及商人支持下发展，犍陀罗等地的雕塑吸收多种文化传统。跨区域贸易、宗教赞助和多语言环境共同塑造了这一时期富有交流特色的社会。
summary.en: The Kushan dynasty ruled important areas between Central and South Asia, connecting diverse populations through cities, trade routes and circulating coinage. Royal and mercantile patronage supported Buddhist institutions and artistic production, while sculpture in regions such as Gandhara drew on several cultural traditions. Commerce, religious sponsorship and multilingual life shaped a society marked by extensive cross-regional interaction.

significance.zh: 加强了中亚、南亚与更远地区之间的贸易和佛教文化联系。
significance.en: Strengthened commercial and Buddhist cultural connections between Central Asia, South Asia and regions beyond.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Cross-regional exchange under the Kushans

editorialNotes.zh: 贵霜早期及迦腻色迦的年代仍有不同年表，本条选取公元100—250年的宽泛交流繁荣阶段。
editorialNotes.en: Chronologies differ for the early Kushans and Kanishka; this entry selects a broad period of flourishing exchange between 100 and 250 CE.

title.zh: 莫切社会的灌溉与艺术

summary.zh: 秘鲁北部沿海的莫切社会利用河流建设灌溉系统，在干旱环境中支撑农业和聚落。大型土砖建筑、精细陶器与金属制品体现了劳动组织和专业技艺，墓葬及图像也记录了社会等级与仪式暴力。各河谷中心通过竞争和交流形成不断变化的关系，留下丰富的安第斯社会史材料。
summary.en: Moche communities on Peru’s northern coast used river-fed irrigation to support farming and settlements in an arid environment. Monumental adobe buildings, elaborate ceramics and metalwork reveal organised labour and specialised skills, while burials and imagery document hierarchy and ritual violence. Relations among valley centres changed through competition and exchange, leaving a rich record of Andean social life.

significance.zh: 展现干旱海岸的农业管理、权力关系与艺术生产。
significance.en: Illuminates agricultural management, relations of power and artistic production on an arid coast.

sources.title: peabody.harvard.edu — Moche irrigation and artistic traditions
The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Moche Decorated Ceramics

editorialNotes.zh: 莫切各河谷的政治统一程度及变化过程仍有争论，研究通常强调区域差异。
editorialNotes.en: The extent and changing nature of political integration among Moche valleys remain debated; research commonly emphasises regional differences.

title.zh: 蔡伦与造纸技术的改进
title.en: Cai Lun and improvements in papermaking

summary.zh: 传统史料记载，蔡伦于105年向汉廷报告改进的造纸方法，使用树皮、麻和破旧织物等纤维材料。更方便制作和使用的纸逐渐扩大了书写材料的选择，并在行政、教育和宗教活动中发挥作用。此后技术经过长期改进与传播，成为不同地区保存和交流文字的重要基础。
summary.en: Traditional accounts associate 105 CE with Cai Lun’s report to the Han court on improved papermaking from fibres including bark, hemp and old textiles. Paper gradually widened the available materials for writing and became important in administration, education and religion. Centuries of technical refinement and transmission later made it fundamental to storing and exchanging written information across many regions.

significance.zh: 推动纸成为日益普及的书写与知识传播材料。
significance.en: Helped paper become an increasingly widespread medium for writing and transmitting knowledge.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Cai Lun and improvements in papermaking

editorialNotes.zh: 考古发现的纸早于蔡伦的记录；105年对应史料中的改进与报告，造纸技术本身经历长期发展。
editorialNotes.en: Archaeological paper predates Cai Lun’s report; 105 CE marks the improvement recorded in historical accounts, within a much longer technological development.

summary.zh: 二世纪后期，一场严重疫病在罗马帝国传播，影响军队、城市居民和帝国资源调度。医师盖伦等人的记述保存了症状及流行情况，也反映了当时应对疾病的知识条件。战争、人口流动和交通网络扩大了人群接触，使这场危机成为研究帝国社会与传染病相互作用的重要案例。
summary.en: A severe epidemic spread through the Roman Empire in the later second century, affecting armies, urban populations and the mobilisation of resources. Accounts associated with Galen and other writers preserve descriptions of illness and contemporary medical understanding. Warfare, population movement and transport networks increased contact among communities, making the crisis important for studying the relationship between imperial society and infectious disease.

significance.zh: 揭示帝国交通、战争和公共健康之间的紧密联系。
significance.en: Reveals close connections among imperial transport, warfare and public health.

sources.title: www.getty.edu — The Antonine epidemic

editorialNotes.zh: 天花是常见的回溯诊断，但病原尚未确定；死亡总数与长期经济影响也难以精确估算。
editorialNotes.en: Smallpox is a common retrospective diagnosis, but the pathogen is not established; total mortality and long-term economic effects are also difficult to estimate precisely.

summary.zh: 190年，关东诸侯起兵讨伐董卓，董卓部将徐荣在荥阳汴水一带迎击联军。曹操率部先行西进，在汴水遭徐荣伏击，士卒伤亡惨重，曹操本人中箭受伤，靠曹洪让马才得以脱险。此役使讨董联军初战受挫，各路诸侯此后多持观望，联军事实上瓦解。
summary.en: In 190, after the eastern warlords rose against Dong Zhuo, his general Xu Rong met the coalition at the Bian River near Xingyang. Cao Cao advanced ahead of the others and was ambushed, losing most of his troops; wounded by arrows, he escaped only because Cao Hong gave him his horse. The defeat broke the coalition's first offensive.

significance.zh: 荥阳之战使讨董联军初战失利并迅速瓦解，为董卓迁都长安与群雄割据的局面铺路。
significance.en: Xingyang broke the coalition's first offensive and hastened both Dong Zhuo's move to Chang'an and the warlord fragmentation.

summary.zh: 191年，讨董联军解体后，袁绍与袁术兄弟反目，双方在阳城交战。袁术部将孙坚自洛阳凯旋后卷入二袁之争，袁绍军一度占据上风，终被孙坚反击击败。公孙瓒之弟公孙越在此役中战死，公孙瓒因此与袁绍结仇，河北与淮南的割据对立由此进一步加深。
summary.en: In 191, as the coalition against Dong Zhuo broke up, the warlords Yuan Shao and Yuan Shu fought at Yangcheng. Sun Jian, Yuan Shu's subordinate, was drawn into the feud on his return from capturing Luoyang; Yuan Shao's force gained the upper hand first but was beaten back. Gongsun Yue, brother of Gongsun Zan, died in the fighting.

significance.zh: 阳城之战使二袁彻底决裂，并把公孙瓒卷入冲突，加速了东汉末年河北与淮南割据局面的形成。
significance.en: Yangcheng turned the feud between the two Yuans into open war, drew in Gongsun Zan and hastened the fragmentation of the late Han north.

summary.zh: 198年冬到199年初，曹操与刘备联军围攻吕布据守的下邳，引沂水、泗水灌城。吕布部将侯成等人开城投降，吕布被擒杀，其割据徐州的力量覆亡。此役消除了曹操在官渡之战前被吕布从后方袭击的隐患，为曹操集中兵力对抗袁绍创造了条件。
summary.en: From the winter of 198 to early 199 Cao Cao and Liu Bei besieged Lü Bu at Xiapi and diverted the Si and Yi rivers to flood the city. Lü Bu's officers opened the gates and he was captured and executed, ending his hold on Xu Province and clearing Cao Cao's rear before the campaign against Yuan Shao.

significance.zh: 下邳之战消灭了吕布势力，使曹操得以在官渡之战前解除后方威胁。
significance.en: Xiapi destroyed Lü Bu's power and freed Cao Cao's rear before the decisive battle of Guandu.

editorialNotes.en: Chinese Wikipedia dates the siege to Jian'an 3 (late 198 to early 199) and English Wikipedia to the winter of 198 to 7 February 199; the entry follows P585, the year 199, at year precision.

summary.zh: 公元200年，袁绍率大军南下进攻曹操，两军在官渡相持数月。曹操先以轻兵袭取白马、延津，后亲率精兵奇袭袁军在乌巢的粮屯，袁军军心崩溃，主力被歼。此战奠定了曹操统一中国北方的基础，曹操随后收编袁绍余部，逐一平定河北诸州，北方大局底定。
summary.en: In 200 AD Yuan Shao marched south against Cao Cao and the two armies faced each other at Guandu for months. Cao Cao raided Baimal and Yanjin, then led a picked force to burn Yuan's grain depot at Wuchao; Yuan's army lost heart and was destroyed. The victory made Cao Cao the dominant power in northern China.

significance.zh: 官渡之战是中国古代以少胜多的经典战例，直接决定了汉末北方的归属。
significance.en: Guandu is the classic Chinese case of a smaller army defeating a larger one and decided who would rule the north at the end of the Han.

editorialNotes.en: Yuan Shao's army is given in later histories as over 100,000 and Cao Cao's numbers are uncertain, both widely thought inflated; this entry keeps year precision.

summary.zh: 208年10月，曹操率轻骑在当阳长坂坡追击南撤的刘备军。刘备弃辎重与家属而走，赵云于乱军中救出刘禅，张飞据水断桥喝退曹军。此役虽以刘备军溃退告终，却使其保存了核心人马，得以退往江夏与孙权结盟，成为赤壁之战的前哨战，也因赵云的救主而广为人知。
summary.en: In October 208 Cao Cao's light cavalry caught Liu Bei's retreating force at Changban near Dangyang. Liu Bei abandoned his baggage and family; Zhao Yun rescued his infant son and Zhang Fei held a broken bridge with a handful of men, deterring pursuit. The defeat nonetheless preserved Liu Bei's core following and led on to the Red Cliffs campaign.

significance.zh: 长坂坡之战使刘备得以保存实力退往江夏，促成孙刘联盟，是赤壁之战的前哨战。
significance.en: Changban let Liu Bei preserve his force and reach Jiangxia, enabling the Sun-Liu alliance that fought at Red Cliffs.

summary.zh: 公元217年夏，罗马皇帝马克里努斯在尼西比斯附近与帕提亚国王阿尔达班四世会战。帕提亚骑兵与骆驼甲兵冲击罗马阵线，双方死伤惨重，罗马一方逐渐不支。战后马克里努斯以巨额赔款换取和平，双方边界大体回到战前状态，此后数年未再大规模交战。
summary.en: In the summer of 217 the Roman emperor Macrinus fought Artabanus IV of Parthia near Nisibis in northern Mesopotamia. Parthian cavalry and armoured camels pressed the Roman line and both sides suffered heavily before Macrinus bought peace with a large indemnity. The frontier returned roughly to its previous state.

significance.zh: 尼西比斯之战结束了卡拉卡拉对帕提亚的冒险，也以赔款暴露了罗马在东方战线的疲惫。
significance.en: Nisibis ended Caracalla's Parthian adventure and the indemnity exposed how strained Rome's eastern front had become.

summary.zh: 公元224年4月28日，波西斯国王阿尔达希尔一世与其子沙普尔在霍尔木兹甘地区击败安息帝国末代君主阿尔达班四世，阿尔达班阵亡。此役终结了安息王朝近五个世纪的统治，阿尔达希尔随后在泰西封加冕，萨珊王朝由此建立，此后与罗马帝国长期对峙。
summary.en: On 28 April 224 Ardashir I of Persis and his son Shapur defeated and killed Artabanus IV, the last Arsacid ruler, at Hormozdgan. The battle ended nearly five centuries of Parthian rule; Ardashir was crowned at Ctesiphon and founded the Sasanian Empire. It reshaped Rome's eastern rival for four centuries.

significance.zh: 霍尔木兹甘之战是伊朗由安息转入萨珊时代的决定性战役，也重塑了罗马东方的对手。
significance.en: Hormozdgan ended the Parthian era and began the Sasanian one, reshaping Rome's eastern rival.

editorialNotes.en: The site is placed variously in what is now Khuzestan and no reliable figures exist for either army; this entry keeps year precision.

title.zh: 玛雅古典时期的城市网络

summary.zh: 玛雅古典时期，低地和高地的众多城市发展出宫殿、神庙、广场与文字记录。统治者通过仪式、战争、婚姻和联盟竞争地位，工匠与书吏创造了精细艺术和历法知识。城市社会依靠复杂的农业与水资源管理维持，区域之间的差异和互动共同塑造了这一繁盛时代。
summary.en: During the Classic period, numerous Maya cities developed palaces, temples, plazas and written records. Rulers competed through ritual, warfare, marriage and alliances, while artists and scribes produced sophisticated imagery and calendrical knowledge. Urban populations depended on varied agricultural and water-management practices, and interactions among distinct regional societies shaped this period of extensive political and cultural activity.

significance.zh: 留下了研究美洲文字、王权、历法与城市生活的丰富材料。
significance.en: Left rich evidence for American writing, kingship, calendars and urban life.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Classic Maya urban networks

summary.zh: 公元251年夏，罗马皇帝德西乌斯率军在默西亚的阿伯里图斯（今保加利亚拉兹格勒）附近与哥特国王尼瓦的联军交战。罗马军被诱入沼泽地带后遭到围歼，德西乌斯与其子赫伦尼乌斯双双阵亡，德西乌斯成为首位在与外敌作战中阵亡的罗马皇帝。
summary.en: In the summer of 251 the Roman emperor Decius fought a Gothic and Scythian coalition under King Cniva near Abritus, modern Razgrad in Bulgaria. The Romans were drawn into marshy ground and destroyed, and Decius and his son Herennius Etruscus were both killed. Decius was the first emperor to die fighting a foreign enemy.

significance.zh: 阿伯里图斯是罗马帝国对哥特人最惨重的败仗之一，也是三世纪危机中皇权动荡的标志性事件。
significance.en: Abritus was one of Rome's worst defeats at Gothic hands and a landmark of imperial instability during the third-century crisis.

summary.zh: 260年，波斯萨珊王朝沙普尔一世在美索不达米亚北部的埃德萨附近击败罗马军队，俘获皇帝瓦勒良，这是罗马皇帝首次被敌方生擒。沙普尔把此事刻在纳克什鲁斯塔姆的浮雕与铭文中。罗马东部边境此后长期由帕尔米拉的奥登纳图斯等地方势力支撑。
summary.en: In 260 Shapur I of the Sasanian empire defeated a Roman army near Edessa in northern Mesopotamia and captured the emperor Valerian, the first Roman emperor taken prisoner by an enemy. Shapur recorded the event in reliefs and inscriptions at Naqsh-e Rostam. Rome's eastern frontier was thereafter held largely by local powers such as Odaenathus of Palmyra.

significance.zh: 埃德萨之败是罗马帝国三世纪危机中最严重的军事耻辱之一。
significance.en: Edessa was one of the gravest military humiliations of Rome's third-century crisis.

editorialNotes.zh: 瓦勒良被俘的经过在罗马与波斯史料中叙述不同，战役年份有259年与260年两说，本条采用260年。
editorialNotes.en: Roman and Persian accounts of Valerian's capture differ, and the year is given as 259 or 260; this entry uses 260.

summary.zh: 公元268年末或269年初，阿勒曼尼人与朱通吉人越过阿尔卑斯山进入意大利北部，罗马皇帝克劳狄二世率军在加尔达湖（古称贝纳库斯湖）沿岸将其击败。此役与纳伊苏斯之战同年，共同构成克劳狄二世阻击蛮族入侵的军事成果，意大利本土得以保全。
summary.en: In late 268 or early 269 the Alamanni and Juthungi crossed the Alps into northern Italy and were defeated by the army of the emperor Claudius II along Lake Garda, known to the Romans as Benacus. Together with Naissus in the same period, the victory checked the invasions and kept Italy proper intact.

significance.zh: 贝纳库斯湖战役阻止了蛮族深入意大利本土，是三世纪危机中罗马少数本土防御成功的战例。
significance.en: Lake Benacus stopped the invaders from penetrating Italy and was one of the few successful homeland defences of the third-century crisis.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of Lake Benacus（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.en: The date is given as late 268 or early 269 and Alamannic numbers are unknown; this entry uses 268 with year precision.

summary.zh: 公元268年（一说269年），罗马军队在默西亚的纳伊苏斯（今塞尔维亚尼什）附近大败入侵巴尔干的哥特人联盟。指挥者通常记为皇帝加里恩努斯或克劳狄二世，此役后哥特人损失惨重，克劳狄二世因此获得哥特征服者称号，奥勒良继续清剿残部。
summary.en: In 268, or possibly 269, Roman forces defeated a Gothic coalition near Naissus, modern Nis in Serbia, after its raids across the Balkans. Command is usually assigned to the emperor Gallienus or to Claudius II, who took the title Gothicus; Aurelian then cleared the remaining invaders.

significance.zh: 此役是三世纪危机中罗马对哥特人最重要的胜利之一，稳住了多瑙河与巴尔干前线。
significance.en: It was one of Rome's most important victories over the Goths during the third-century crisis and steadied the Danube frontier.

editorialNotes.en: The year is given as 268 or 269 and command is disputed between Gallienus and Claudius II; this entry uses 268 with year precision.

title.zh: 占婆美山圣地持续营建
title.en: Building the Cham sanctuary of My Son

summary.zh: 从公元四世纪起，占婆统治者和宗教团体在越南中部山谷中的美山持续营建塔庙。湿婆崇拜在这里占有重要地位，工匠以砖墙、砂岩构件和精细雕刻表达神灵与王权的联系。历代修建把南亚宗教观念与占人的地方艺术相结合，留下占婆政治和信仰变化的长时段记录。
summary.en: From the fourth century, Cham rulers and religious communities repeatedly developed My Son in a valley of central Vietnam. Worship of Shiva held an important place, expressed through brick towers, sandstone elements and elaborate carving. Successive building phases connected royal authority with sacred practice, adapting South Asian religious ideas to Cham artistic traditions and preserving a long record of political and religious change.

significance.zh: 美山记录了占婆社会对跨海宗教文化的主动吸收与创造。
significance.en: My Son records the creative adaptation of religious traditions through Cham maritime connections.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：美山圣地

summary.zh: 312年10月，君士坦丁在罗马城外的米尔维安大桥击败马克森提乌斯，后者在台伯河溺亡。据古代作家记载，君士坦丁在战前见到十字架异象，遂以基督教符号作为军队标志。此役使他成为西罗马唯一的奥古斯都，通常被视为基督教与罗马帝国关系的转折点。
summary.en: In October 312 Constantine defeated Maxentius at the Milvian Bridge outside Rome, and Maxentius drowned in the Tiber. Ancient writers report that Constantine saw a vision before the battle and adopted a Christian sign for his troops. The victory made him sole Augustus in the west and is traditionally seen as a turning point between Christianity and the empire.

significance.zh: 米尔维安大桥把君士坦丁推上西罗马独尊地位，为基督教在帝国的合法化铺路。
significance.en: The Milvian Bridge made Constantine sole ruler in the west and prepared the legalisation of Christianity.

title.zh: 罗马帝国的宗教宽容安排
title.en: Religious toleration in the Roman Empire

summary.zh: 313年，君士坦丁与李锡尼达成宗教宽容安排，基督徒及其他群体获得更有保障的信仰空间，被没收的教会财产也获准归还。这些措施改变了此前迫害所造成的处境，促使基督教社群更公开地组织活动。皇权与教会的联系随之加深，罗马帝国的宗教政治进入新的阶段。
summary.en: In 313, Constantine and Licinius agreed on measures of religious toleration, providing greater security for Christians and other worshippers and allowing confiscated church property to be restored. These arrangements changed conditions created by earlier persecution and enabled Christian communities to operate more openly. Relations between imperial power and the church deepened, opening a new phase in Roman religious politics.

significance.zh: 改善了基督教社群的法律处境，并改变皇权与宗教的关系。
significance.en: Improved the legal position of Christian communities and altered relations between imperial power and religion.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Religious toleration in the Roman Empire

editorialNotes.zh: 常称《米兰敕令》的安排由不同文本传世；帝国后来确立基督教正统地位是另一阶段的发展。
editorialNotes.en: The arrangement conventionally called the Edict of Milan survives through different texts; the later establishment of Christian orthodoxy was a subsequent development.

title.zh: 笈多王朝与古典文化发展
title.en: The Gupta dynasty and classical cultural development

summary.zh: 四至六世纪，笈多王朝在北印度扩展影响，王室、地方精英和宗教机构共同参与政治与文化生活。梵语文学、数学、天文学及寺庙艺术获得发展，各地区也延续自己的语言和社会传统。政权的赞助与广泛交流为学术和艺术创造提供条件，使这一时期在南亚文化史中占有重要位置。
summary.en: From the fourth to sixth centuries, Gupta rulers expanded their influence in northern India, alongside local elites and religious institutions. Sanskrit literature, mathematics, astronomy and temple arts developed within a society that retained substantial regional diversity. Patronage and wider networks of exchange supported scholarly and artistic work, giving the period an important place in South Asian cultural history.

significance.zh: 促进了对后世影响深远的南亚学术和艺术传统。
significance.en: Supported South Asian scholarly and artistic traditions with a long-lasting influence.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Gupta dynasty and classical cultural development

title.zh: 阿克苏姆王权采用基督教
title.en: Royal adoption of Christianity at Aksum

summary.zh: 四世纪，阿克苏姆王权在埃扎纳统治时期采用基督教，王室符号、钱币与铭文逐渐反映新的宗教认同。位于红海与非洲内陆交往网络中的王国，通过宗教人物和商业联系参与更广泛的基督教世界。新的信仰在地方社会中持续发展，成为埃塞俄比亚和厄立特里亚历史的重要组成部分。
summary.en: In the fourth century, Aksumite kingship adopted Christianity under Ezana, with royal symbols, coins and inscriptions increasingly reflecting the new affiliation. Situated within networks linking the Red Sea and inland Africa, the kingdom participated in wider Christian connections through religious figures and commerce. The faith continued to develop locally and became central to Ethiopian and Eritrean history.

significance.zh: 奠定了非洲之角长期基督教传统的重要基础。
significance.en: Helped establish the enduring Christian traditions of the Horn of Africa.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Royal adoption of Christianity at Aksum

summary.zh: 公元351年9月28日，东部皇帝君士坦提乌斯二世与西部篡位者马格嫩提乌斯在潘诺尼亚的穆尔萨（今克罗地亚奥西耶克）附近决战。双方投入大量蛮族部队，战斗极其惨烈，马格嫩提乌斯战败退往意大利。此役虽保住君士坦提乌斯的皇位，却严重消耗了帝国的兵力。
summary.en: On 28 September 351 the eastern emperor Constantius II and the western usurper Magnentius fought at Mursa in Pannonia, modern Osijek in Croatia. Both sides fielded large barbarian contingents in one of the bloodiest battles of Roman history, and Magnentius withdrew towards Italy. Constantius kept the throne but the empire's manpower was badly drained.

significance.zh: 穆尔萨是罗马内战中最血腥的战役之一，其消耗加速了高卢与巴尔干防线的空虚。
significance.en: Mursa was among the bloodiest of Roman civil-war battles and its cost accelerated the weakening of the Rhine and Balkan frontiers.

summary.zh: 378年8月，东罗马皇帝瓦伦斯在色雷斯的阿德里安堡附近与哥特人交战。罗马军队在酷热中长途行军后仓促投入战斗，骑兵未能及时支援，左翼崩溃，瓦伦斯阵亡。此役是罗马帝国自条顿堡森林以来最惨重的失败，迫使继位的狄奥多西一世与哥特人签订和约并接纳其定居。
summary.en: In August 378 the eastern emperor Valens fought the Goths near Adrianople in Thrace. The Roman army attacked after a long march in the heat, its cavalry failed to support the left wing, and the line collapsed; Valens was killed. It was Rome's worst defeat since the Teutoburg Forest and forced Theodosius I to settle the Goths inside the empire.

significance.zh: 阿德里安堡暴露了罗马野战军的脆弱，加速了哥特人作为帝国内部力量的崛起。
significance.en: Adrianople exposed the fragility of the Roman field army and accelerated the Goths' rise inside the empire.

summary.zh: 公元383年秋，前秦君主苻坚率号称八十余万的大军南征东晋，两军在淝水（今安徽寿县一带）对峙。晋军要求秦军后撤以便渡河决战，秦军后撤时阵脚大乱，晋军趁势猛攻并大败秦军。前秦由此瓦解，北方重新分裂，境内各族势力纷纷自立，北方再度陷入分裂。
summary.en: In the autumn of 383 the Former Qin ruler Fu Jian invaded the Eastern Jin with a vastly larger army and the two forces faced each other at the Fei River in Anhui. When Qin troops stepped back to let the Jin cross, their line collapsed and the Jin counter-attacked, routing them. Former Qin broke apart and the north fragmented.

significance.zh: 淝水之战保住了东晋政权，并确立了此后近两百年南北分立的格局。
significance.en: Fei River preserved the Eastern Jin state and fixed the north-south division of China for nearly two centuries.

title.zh: 那烂陀的学术寺院发展
title.en: Development of the monastic learning centre at Nalanda

summary.zh: 那烂陀在印度东北部发展为大型佛教寺院和学术中心，吸引来自亚洲不同地区的僧人与学生。教学涉及佛教经典、逻辑、语言及其他知识，寺院建筑和赞助网络支撑了长期学习生活。求学者携带文本与解释传统往返，使那烂陀成为南亚与更广泛佛教世界交流的重要节点。
summary.en: Nalanda in northeastern India developed into a major Buddhist monastic and scholarly centre, attracting monks and students from across Asia. Instruction included Buddhist texts, logic, language and other fields, supported by substantial buildings and networks of patronage. Travelling scholars carried texts and interpretations between regions, making Nalanda an important connection between South Asia and the wider Buddhist world.

significance.zh: 推动了亚洲学术旅行、文本传播与佛教知识交流。
significance.en: Advanced scholarly travel, textual transmission and Buddhist learning across Asia.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Development of the monastic learning centre at Nalanda

editorialNotes.en: Its establishment and decline unfolded in stages; 450–1200 is a rounded interval for its major period of development.

title.zh: 梅萨维德聚落与悬崖村落发展
title.en: Settlements and cliff dwellings develop at Mesa Verde

summary.zh: 从公元五世纪中叶起，普韦布洛先民在梅萨维德高原长期聚居，住宅逐渐从地穴式建筑发展为砌石村落和悬崖下的多层居所。梯地、蓄水设施与沟渠支持耕作，公共仪式空间连接家庭与社区。保存下来的建筑与农田遗迹，呈现了居民适应高原环境及共同生活方式的持续变化。
summary.en: From the mid-fifth century, Ancestral Pueblo communities occupied the Mesa Verde plateau, developing pit houses, masonry villages and eventually multistorey cliff dwellings. Agricultural terraces, reservoirs and ditches supported cultivation, while ceremonial spaces linked households and communities. Surviving buildings and field systems document changing forms of cooperation and adaptation to the plateau environment across many generations.

significance.zh: 梅萨维德把古代聚落史与今天普韦布洛族群的文化传承联系起来。
significance.en: Mesa Verde connects the history of ancestral settlements with the continuing heritage of Pueblo peoples.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：梅萨维德国家公园

summary.zh: 451年，西罗马将领埃提乌斯联合西哥特等部族，在香槟地区的沙隆附近阻止匈人阿提拉的推进。双方伤亡惨重，阿提拉撤退，西欧免于被匈人直接统治。此役被视为西罗马帝国晚期最后一次大规模联军作战，也加速了蛮族王国在高卢的定型，双方都付出了高昂代价。
summary.en: In 451 the Roman general Aetius, allied with Visigoths and other peoples, checked the advance of Attila's Huns near Chalons in Champagne. Losses on both sides were heavy and Attila withdrew, leaving western Europe outside direct Hunnic rule. The battle was the last great coalition campaign of the Western Roman Empire.

significance.zh: 沙隆战役阻止了匈人势力进入西欧，改变了五世纪高卢的政治格局。
significance.en: The Catalaunian Plains stopped Hunnic power short of western Europe and reshaped fifth-century Gaul.

summary.zh: 451年，亚美尼亚贵族瓦尔丹·马米科尼扬率军在东部的阿瓦拉尔平原迎战萨珊波斯军队，阻止其强制推行祆教。亚美尼亚一方战败，瓦尔丹阵亡，但波斯此后未再强行改宗。此役被亚美尼亚教会封为圣战，瓦尔丹成为民族记忆中的核心人物，其纪念日延续至今。
summary.en: In 451 Vardan Mamikonian led an Armenian army against Sasanian Persian forces on the plain of Avarayr to resist the imposition of Zoroastrianism. The Armenians were defeated and Vardan was killed, but the Persians did not enforce conversion afterwards. The battle is commemorated as a holy struggle and Vardan remains a central figure of Armenian memory.

significance.zh: 阿瓦拉尔虽败，却保住了亚美尼亚的基督教认同，成为民族与教会记忆的核心事件。
significance.en: Avarayr was a military defeat that preserved Armenian Christian identity and became a founding memory.

title.en: Deposition of the western Roman emperor

summary.zh: 476年，奥多亚塞在意大利废黜西部皇帝罗慕路斯·奥古斯都，结束了当时意大利的西罗马皇帝统治。地方精英、城市制度和罗马法律传统继续存在，东部帝国也延续政治与文化生活。这一事件处于西方权力长期重组的过程之中，后来成为欧洲历史分期中广为使用的转折年份。
summary.en: In 476, Odoacer deposed Romulus Augustulus in Italy, ending the reigning western imperial court there. Local elites, urban institutions and Roman legal traditions continued, as did the political and cultural life of the eastern empire. The event formed part of a prolonged redistribution of western power and later became a widely used turning point in European historical periodisation.

significance.zh: 象征西部帝国统治的变化，同时揭示罗马传统的延续。
significance.en: Symbolises the transformation of western imperial rule while revealing the survival of Roman traditions.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — Deposition of the western Roman emperor

editorialNotes.zh: 476年属于后世常用的分期节点；西部皇位的合法性、地方政权和制度延续具有更复杂的时间线。
editorialNotes.en: 476 is a conventional later period boundary; imperial legitimacy, regional governments and institutional continuity followed more complex chronologies.

summary.zh: 489年8月28日，东哥特国王狄奥多里克大帝率军在阿奎莱亚附近的伊松提乌斯河畔迎战奥多亚塞，争夺意大利的统治权。狄奥多里克获胜，奥多亚塞退往维罗纳，双方随后又多次交锋。此役是狄奥多里克征服意大利的开端，奥多亚塞在意大利十余年的统治由此动摇。
summary.en: On 28 August 489 Theodoric the Great, king of the Ostrogoths, defeated Odoacer's army on the banks of the Isontius river near Aquileia in the opening campaign for Italy. Odoacer withdrew towards Verona, where the two sides fought again later that year, beginning the war that ended his rule.

significance.zh: 伊松佐河之战是狄奥多里克征服意大利的第一场胜利，开启了东哥特王国取代奥多亚塞统治的进程。
significance.en: It was Theodoric's first victory in the conquest of Italy and began the Ostrogothic replacement of Odoacer's rule.

title.zh: 阿耶波多的数学天文学著作

summary.zh: 499年，阿耶波多撰成以简练诗句组织的数学天文学著作，讨论计算方法、三角函数、行星运动及地球自转等问题。他把数学技巧与天体观察联系起来，为历法和位置计算提供工具。后来的学者通过注释、批评和修订延续这一传统，使著作在南亚及跨区域知识交流中产生持续影响。
summary.en: In 499, Aryabhata composed a concise mathematical and astronomical work addressing calculation, trigonometric relationships, planetary motion and the rotation of the Earth. He linked mathematical techniques with the study of celestial phenomena, offering tools for calendars and positional calculation. Later scholars sustained this tradition through commentary, criticism and revision, giving the work a lasting role in South Asian and wider knowledge exchange.

significance.zh: 将数学计算与天文模型结合，影响了后续历法和学术传统。
significance.en: Joined mathematical calculation with astronomical modelling and influenced later calendrical and scholarly traditions.

summary.zh: 尼日尔河内三角洲的杰内—杰诺及周边聚落依靠农业、渔业和区域交换逐步扩展。居民从事铁器等手工业，与不同生态区的社群联系，形成相互依赖的城市网络。考古材料展示了西非城市生活的发展，也让研究者关注商贸、专业分工和地方合作如何共同组织大型聚居地。
summary.en: Jenne-jeno and neighbouring settlements in the inland Niger delta expanded through farming, fishing and regional exchange. Craftspeople worked iron and other materials, while connections with different ecological zones supported an interdependent urban network. Archaeology documents the development of West African city life and the roles of commerce, specialised production and local cooperation in organising large settlements.

significance.zh: 丰富了对西非城市化及其多种组织方式的理解。
significance.en: Broadens understanding of West African urbanisation and its varied forms of organisation.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Urban networks at Jenne-jeno

editorialNotes.zh: 本条选取500—850年的扩展阶段；杰内—杰诺的居住历史更早，政治组织方式仍在研究中。
editorialNotes.en: This entry selects an expansion phase from 500 to 850; occupation began earlier, and the nature of political organisation remains under study.

title.zh: 蒂瓦纳库的高原政治中心
title.en: Tiwanaku as an Andean highland centre

summary.zh: 蒂瓦纳库在的的喀喀湖附近成长为安第斯高原的重要政治与仪式中心。石构建筑、雕塑和公共空间汇集权威与信仰，周围农业及跨生态区联系支持人口和手工业。其文化影响向外扩展，人群与物资的流动将高原、山谷和沿海地区相接，形成复杂的区域关系。
summary.en: Tiwanaku near Lake Titicaca grew into a major political and ceremonial centre of the Andean highlands. Stone architecture, sculpture and public spaces expressed authority and belief, supported by agriculture and connections across ecological zones. Its cultural influence spread as people and goods moved among highlands, valleys and coastal regions, creating a complex set of regional relationships.

significance.zh: 展现高原环境中农业、仪式与跨区域政治联系的结合。
significance.en: Shows how agriculture, ritual and interregional political connections developed in a highland environment.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Tiwanaku as an Andean highland centre

editorialNotes.zh: 所列500—900年为主要繁荣阶段；蒂瓦纳库对外围地区的控制形式和衰落原因仍有讨论。
editorialNotes.en: 500–900 marks a principal phase of flourishing; the forms of authority in peripheral regions and the causes of decline remain debated.

title.zh: 迪基斯首领聚落与石球艺术发展
title.en: Diquis chiefly settlements and stone spheres

summary.zh: 公元六至十五世纪，哥斯达黎加南部迪基斯三角洲的社群营建具有不同等级中心的聚落。人工土台、铺石空间、墓地与大型石球共同组织居住和公共活动。工匠把巨石加工为规整的球体，并将其置于聚落之中；这些工程显示了专业技艺、劳动协作和地方权力结构的发展。
summary.en: From the sixth through fifteenth centuries, communities in southern Costa Rica's Diquis delta developed settlements with centres of differing rank. Raised platforms, paved areas, burial grounds and large stone spheres organized residential and communal space. Artisans shaped massive stones into regular spheres and placed them within settlements, demonstrating specialized craft knowledge, collective labour and developing local political structures.

significance.zh: 迪基斯石球是中美洲南部社会组织与工艺传统的重要物质记录。
significance.en: Diquis spheres are important material evidence of social organization and craft traditions in southern Central America.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：迪基斯石球首领聚落

editorialNotes.zh: 石球的具体用途、象征含义和部分制造步骤仍未完全厘清。
editorialNotes.en: The spheres' specific uses, symbolic meanings and some manufacturing procedures remain incompletely understood.

summary.zh: 507年春，法兰克国王克洛维一世率军在普瓦捷附近的武耶击败西哥特国王阿拉里克二世，阿拉里克阵亡。西哥特人退出高卢大部，法兰克人夺取阿基坦，克洛维随后定都巴黎。此役使法兰克王国成为西欧最强势力，也被后世视为法国王权叙事的起点之一。
summary.en: In the spring of 507 Clovis, king of the Franks, defeated the Visigothic army of Alaric II at Vouille near Poitiers; Alaric was killed and the Visigoths lost most of their Gallic territory. The victory gave the Franks Aquitania and made Clovis the strongest ruler in western Europe.

significance.zh: 武耶之战使法兰克人取代西哥特人成为高卢的主导力量，奠定了法兰克王国在西欧的霸权。
significance.en: Vouille replaced Visigothic with Frankish dominance in Gaul and laid the foundation of the Frankish kingdom's supremacy in western Europe.

summary.zh: 公元530年6月，萨珊波斯军队进攻美索不达米亚边境要塞达拉，贝利撒留率兵力较少的东罗马军队应战。他在城外挖壕沟限制波斯骑兵的机动，让对方反复冲击中央，再以两翼骑兵反击取胜。普罗科匹厄斯的记述使此役成为晚期罗马战术最详细的战例之一。
summary.en: In June 530 a Sasanian army advanced on the fortress of Dara in Mesopotamia and met a smaller Byzantine force under Belisarius. Trenches outside the walls restricted Persian cavalry movement; the Byzantines absorbed repeated assaults on their centre and counter-attacked from the wings. Procopius left one of the fullest accounts of late Roman tactics.

significance.zh: 达拉之战确立了贝利撒留的声望，也展示了东罗马以工事与预备队抵消波斯骑兵优势的战法。
significance.en: Dara made Belisarius's reputation and showed how fortifications and reserves could offset Persian cavalry superiority.

summary.zh: 公元533年9月13日，贝利撒留率东罗马远征军在迦太基附近的阿德底斯姆击败汪达尔国王格列摩尔。汪达尔军在分进合击中指挥失序，格列摩尔见其弟阵亡后脱离战场，贝利撒留趁势夺取迦太基。汪达尔王国由此迅速瓦解，北非重回罗马治下。
summary.en: On 13 September 533 a Byzantine expedition under Belisarius defeated the Vandal king Gelimer at Ad Decimum near Carthage. The Vandal counter-attack lost coordination and Gelimer left the field after his brother was killed, allowing Belisarius to take Carthage. The Vandal kingdom collapsed and North Africa returned to Roman rule.

significance.zh: 阿德底斯姆之战是查士丁尼西部再征服的第一场决战，汪达尔王国的覆亡由此开始。
significance.en: Ad Decimum was the first decisive battle of Justinian's reconquest in the west and began the collapse of the Vandal kingdom.

summary.zh: 541年起，鼠疫在东地中海及周边地区传播，随后袭击君士坦丁堡。文献描写了疾病带来的死亡、劳动力损失和日常秩序受扰，古代病原DNA研究则帮助确认了鼠疫杆菌的存在。此后数代人的反复流行，使疾病成为理解晚期古代人口、交通与社会变化的重要因素。
summary.en: From 541, plague spread through the eastern Mediterranean and surrounding regions, reaching Constantinople soon afterward. Written accounts describe deaths, disrupted work and disturbances to everyday life, while ancient pathogen DNA has helped identify Yersinia pestis. Recurrent outbreaks over subsequent generations make the disease an important part of research into late antique populations, transport and social change.

significance.zh: 将文献和古代DNA证据结合，用于研究早期鼠疫流行。
significance.en: Brings written and ancient DNA evidence together in the study of early plague outbreaks.

summary.zh: 六世纪末至七世纪初，伊奢那补罗成为真腊的重要都城。城市把居住区、道路、水利设施与砖石寺庙结合起来，工匠在塔庙和门楣上发展出鲜明的地方风格。梵文与古高棉文铭文记录了供奉和统治活动，这一时期的建筑与雕刻为后来吴哥艺术的发展积累了经验。
summary.en: In the late sixth and early seventh centuries, Ishanapura became an important capital of Chenla. Residential areas, roads and waterworks connected with brick and sandstone temples, whose towers and lintels developed a distinctive local style. Sanskrit and Old Khmer inscriptions recorded religious endowments and political life. The complex helped establish architectural and sculptural practices that later flourished at Angkor.

significance.zh: 展现了吴哥兴起以前高棉城市、文字与宗教艺术的发展。
significance.en: Documents Khmer urban life, writing and sacred art before the rise of Angkor.

summary.zh: 589年，隋军灭陈，结束了长期南北分立的主要政治格局。统一政权整合官僚制度、税收与军事组织，进一步连接南北经济和交通。此后大规模工程及战争加重了社会负担，隋朝迅速灭亡，但它完成的政治整合和行政建设成为唐朝发展的重要基础。
summary.en: In 589, Sui forces defeated the Chen dynasty, bringing an end to the principal political division between northern and southern China. The unified government integrated administration, taxation and military organisation while strengthening economic and transport connections. Large projects and warfare later imposed heavy burdens and contributed to rapid collapse, but Sui integration and institutions provided important foundations for the Tang.

significance.zh: 为唐代的政治整合和经济联系奠定基础。
significance.en: Laid foundations for Tang political integration and economic connections.

title.zh: 奇琴伊察的建筑与区域交流
title.en: Architecture and regional exchange at Chichen Itza

summary.zh: 七至十二世纪，奇琴伊察围绕尤卡坦半岛的天然水井逐渐扩展。工匠营建神庙、柱廊、大球场和圆形建筑，把玛雅传统与墨西哥中部流行的形式结合起来。宏大的公共空间承载宗教仪式与政治活动，城市的建筑和雕刻也把尤卡坦与更广泛的中美洲文化网络联系起来。
summary.en: Between the seventh and twelfth centuries, Chichen Itza expanded around natural cenotes in the Yucatan Peninsula. Artisans built temples, colonnades, a great ball court and circular structures that combined Maya traditions with forms shared in central Mexico. Monumental public spaces supported religious and political activities, while architecture and sculpture connected Yucatan with wider Mesoamerican cultural networks.

significance.zh: 奇琴伊察体现了古典期之后玛雅城市的延续与跨区域艺术交流。
significance.en: Chichen Itza illustrates the continuation of Maya urban life and interregional artistic exchange after the Classic period.

sources.title: UNESCO世界遗产中心：奇琴伊察古城
墨西哥国家人类学与历史研究所：奇琴伊察与托尔特克问题

editorialNotes.zh: 建筑联系有多种解释；把全部变化归于一次托尔特克入侵的旧式叙述并无充分共识。
editorialNotes.en: Architectural connections have several interpretations; a single Toltec invasion is not a settled explanation for all changes.

title.en: Expansion of the Grand Canal under the Sui

summary.zh: 隋朝在既有水道基础上扩建运河，将黄河、淮河与长江流域的交通进一步贯通。运河便于粮食、军队和物资向政治中心集中，也加强了南北地区的经济联系。工程征发消耗了大量人力，成为当时社会压力的重要来源；长期使用和后续改造又使大运河成为中国交通与供给体系的骨干。
summary.en: The Sui expanded existing waterways into a canal system linking the Yellow, Huai and Yangtze river regions. It moved grain, troops and supplies toward political centres and strengthened north–south economic connections. Construction demanded extensive labour and created severe social pressures, while continued use and later improvements made the Grand Canal a backbone of transport and provisioning in China.

significance.zh: 大规模水运加强了国家供给体系与南北经济联系。
significance.en: Large-scale water transport strengthened state provisioning and economic links between northern and southern China.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Expansion of the Grand Canal under the Sui

title.zh: 唐朝建立与长安的交流网络
title.en: Foundation of the Tang and Chang’an’s networks

summary.zh: 618年建立的唐朝继承并调整隋代制度，在此后数代统治者治下扩大影响。都城长安汇集商人、使节、宗教人士和学生，来自亚洲不同地区的人群参与城市生活。外交、贸易和文化赞助推动文学、艺术与知识发展，唐代也在边疆战争和内部权力竞争中不断改变。
summary.en: Founded in 618, the Tang dynasty adapted Sui institutions and expanded its influence under successive rulers. Chang’an brought together merchants, envoys, religious figures and students from across Asia. Diplomacy, commerce and cultural patronage supported literature, art and learning, while frontier warfare and internal struggles continually reshaped the dynasty’s political and social life.

significance.zh: 长安成为中世纪亚洲政治往来和文化交流的重要中心。
significance.en: Chang’an became an important centre of political contact and cultural exchange in medieval Asia.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Foundation of the Tang and Chang’an’s networks

summary.zh: 621年5月，李世民率唐军在洛阳以东的虎牢关击溃窦建德统率的夏军主力，窦建德兵败被俘，困守洛阳的王世充随即出降。此役是唐初统一战争的决定性会战，一举消灭中原两大割据势力。李世民以少胜多、据险待疲的指挥也常被后世兵家称道。
summary.en: In May 621 Li Shimin led a smaller Tang army to Hulao Pass east of Luoyang and destroyed the Xia host of Dou Jiande, who was captured; Wang Shichong, besieged in Luoyang, surrendered soon afterwards. The victory eliminated the two strongest rival polities of the Central Plains and decided the Tang unification of China.

significance.zh: 虎牢之战一举摧毁夏、郑两大割据政权，为唐朝统一中原奠定了基础。
significance.en: Hulao destroyed the Xia and Zheng regimes and secured Tang control of the Central Plains.

title.zh: 希吉拉：穆罕默德迁徙麦地那

summary.zh: 622年，穆罕默德及其追随者从麦加迁往麦地那，在当地建立新的共同体关系。宗教实践与政治协商日益交织，追随者通过相互支持、盟约和集体行动应对外部冲突。此次迁徙成为伊斯兰教早期历史的重要转折，后来被选为伊斯兰历纪元，持续影响穆斯林社会的时间记忆。
summary.en: In 622, Muhammad and his followers moved from Mecca to Medina, where they established new communal relationships. Religious practice became closely connected with political negotiation as followers used mutual support, agreements and collective action to meet external challenges. The migration became a decisive episode in early Islamic history and was later chosen as the starting point of the Islamic calendar.

significance.zh: 推动了早期穆斯林共同体的形成，并成为伊斯兰历的纪元。
significance.en: Advanced the formation of the early Muslim community and became the epoch of the Islamic calendar.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica（专业百科） — The Hijra to Medina

summary.zh: 624年，穆罕默德率穆斯林队伍在阿拉伯半岛汉志地区的白德尔泉附近截击麦加古莱什商队，与前来护送的麦加军队交战。穆斯林一方人数处于劣势却取胜，古莱什首领阿布·贾赫勒阵亡。此役被穆斯林视为决定性的胜利，也是《古兰经》少数明确提到的事件之一。
summary.en: In 624 Muhammad led a Muslim force to intercept a Meccan caravan near the wells of Badr in the Hejaz and met the Quraysh army sent to protect it. Though outnumbered, the Muslims won and the Quraysh leader Abu Jahl was killed. The battle is remembered as a decisive early victory of Islam.

significance.zh: 白德尔之战巩固了麦地那穆斯林群体的地位，是伊斯兰教早期最重要的军事事件。
significance.en: Badr secured the Muslim community in Medina and is the founding military victory of Islam.

维基百科 — 巴德尔之役（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.en: Conversion between the Hijri and Gregorian calendars gives 13 or 14 March 624; this entry keeps the year 624 as its precision.

summary.zh: 625年，麦加古莱什军队为白德尔之败复仇，在麦地那附近的乌胡德山与穆罕默德率领的穆斯林军队交战。穆斯林弓箭手擅自离开阵地争夺战利品，麦加骑兵趁机从侧后突袭，穆斯林一方失利，穆罕默德本人受伤。此役促使穆斯林调整战术与纪律，也加深了麦地那内部的阵营分化。
summary.en: In 625 a Meccan force seeking revenge for Badr met Muhammad's army near Mount Uhud outside Medina. Muslim archers left their position to collect spoils, Meccan cavalry attacked from the rear, and the Muslims were defeated; Muhammad himself was wounded. The setback led to tighter discipline and deepened divisions inside Medina.

significance.zh: 乌胡德战役暴露了穆斯林军队的纪律弱点，是白德尔之后伊斯兰早期史的重要转折。
significance.en: Uhud exposed the discipline problem in the Muslim army and marks a turning point after Badr.

title.zh: 婆罗摩笈多论零与负数
title.en: Brahmagupta on zero and negative numbers

summary.zh: 628年，婆罗摩笈多在数学天文学著作中讨论零、正负数及相关运算，并处理方程、几何和天体计算问题。他将计算规则纳入天文学知识体系，使抽象数的性质与历法、观测任务相联系。后来的注释与跨语言传播让这些成果进入更广阔的学术网络，成为数学发展史中的重要环节。
summary.en: In 628, Brahmagupta discussed zero, positive and negative numbers and their operations in a mathematical and astronomical work, alongside equations, geometry and celestial calculations. He placed computational rules within a framework connecting numerical ideas to calendars and observation. Later commentary and transmission across languages carried these results into wider scholarly networks and made them important in mathematical history.

significance.zh: 系统讨论了零和负数运算，丰富了后续数学传统。
significance.en: Systematically discussed operations involving zero and negative numbers and enriched later mathematical traditions.

sources.title: University of St Andrews — MacTutor: Brahmagupta

editorialNotes.zh: 古代关于除以零的处理与现代定义不同，应在当时数学体系中理解。
editorialNotes.en: Ancient treatments of division by zero differ from modern definitions and should be understood within their historical mathematical setting.

summary.zh: 629年，穆罕默德派出的使团在拜占庭势力范围遇袭后，一支约三千人的穆斯林队伍北上，在死海以东的穆厄塔与拜占庭及阿拉伯部落联军交战。三位穆斯林指挥官相继阵亡，哈立德·本·瓦利德接掌指挥并率军撤退。此役虽未取胜，却成为伊斯兰势力与拜占庭帝国直接冲突的开端。
summary.en: In 629, after a Muslim envoy was killed in the Byzantine sphere, a force of about three thousand marched north and met Byzantine and allied Arab troops at Mu'tah east of the Dead Sea. Three Muslim commanders fell in turn before Khalid ibn al-Walid took over and withdrew the army. The battle opened direct conflict between the Muslims and Byzantium.

significance.zh: 穆厄塔是穆斯林军队与拜占庭帝国的首次交锋，为后来的叙利亚征服积累经验。
significance.en: Mu'tah was the first clash between Muslim forces and Byzantium and prepared the later conquest of Syria.

title.zh: 早期哈里发国家的扩张

summary.zh: 穆罕默德去世后，早期哈里发统治者率军向阿拉伯半岛之外扩张，将叙利亚、埃及、伊朗等地区纳入新的权力结构。倭马亚王朝以大马士革为中心继续扩大统治，整合地方行政、税收与货币制度。阿拉伯语和伊斯兰制度逐步发展，各地社会也在延续既有传统的同时参与新的政治与文化网络。
summary.en: After Muhammad’s death, early caliphs expanded beyond Arabia, bringing Syria, Egypt, Iran and other regions into a new political order. The Umayyads ruled from Damascus and extended their authority while integrating local administration, taxation and coinage. Arabic and Islamic institutions grew in importance as regional societies maintained established practices and participated in new political and cultural networks.

significance.zh: 重塑西亚、北非及更广泛地区的政治联系与文化交流。
significance.en: Reshaped political connections and cultural exchange across western Asia, North Africa and beyond.

summary.zh: 公元634年7月或8月，正统哈里发国的阿拉伯军队与拜占庭帝国军队在今以色列贝特古夫林附近交战，这是双方第一次大规模会战。穆斯林军队在哈立德等将领指挥下击败拜占庭军队，打开了巴勒斯坦的门户。战役细节主要来自九世纪阿拉伯史家瓦基迪的记载。
summary.en: In July or August 634 the army of the Rashidun Caliphate fought the Byzantine Empire near Bayt Jibrin, the first major pitched battle between the two. The Muslims, led by commanders including Khalid ibn al-Walid, defeated the Byzantine force and opened Palestine to conquest. Details come mainly from later Muslim writers such as al-Waqidi.

significance.zh: 此役打破了拜占庭在叙利亚与巴勒斯坦的野战威慑，为雅尔穆克战役和黎凡特征服铺平道路。
significance.en: It broke Byzantine field power in Syria and Palestine and paved the way for Yarmouk and the conquest of the Levant.

title.en: The Daming Palace and the palace city of Tang Chang'an

summary.zh: 634年，唐朝廷在长安城东北的龙首原营建大明宫，此后成为皇帝听政与居住的主要宫城。宫城沿南北中轴排列含元殿、宣政殿与紫宸殿，朝会、政务与内廷活动分区展开。大明宫与郭城、里坊和东西市共同构成唐长安的都城秩序，其宫室布局也影响了东亚其他都城的建设。
summary.en: In 634 the Tang court began building the Daming Palace on high ground northeast of Chang'an, and it became the main palace where emperors held audience and governed. Halls arranged along a north–south axis separated ceremonial, administrative and residential functions. Together with the outer city, wards and markets, the palace expressed the spatial order of the Tang capital.

significance.zh: 大明宫体现了唐代宫城制度与都城规划的结合。
significance.en: The Daming Palace exemplifies how Tang palace institutions and capital planning were combined.

sources.title: Xi'an Municipal Government — Ancient city celebrates new national 5A-level scenic spot

editorialNotes.zh: 634年为始建之年，此后多次增修；本条不把某一殿的落成年份当作整座宫城的完成时间。
editorialNotes.en: 634 is the year construction began; halls were added later, so no single hall date is treated as completion of the whole palace city.
