editorialNotes.en: Estimates of Hemu's army range from tens of thousands to 100,000 and the number of guns is disputed; this entry keeps year precision.

title.zh: 阿克巴时期的帝国整合与宫廷文化
title.en: Imperial consolidation and court culture under Akbar

summary.zh: 1556年阿克巴继位后，莫卧儿帝国通过军事征服、联姻与行政改革把北印度和德干部分地区纳入统治。皇帝在法泰赫普尔西克里与拉合尔等地的宫廷中集合波斯、印度与中亚的工匠、画家和学者，推行翻译与宗教辩论。这种整合扩大了帝国的税基，也留下了多语言、多宗教的宫廷文化。
summary.en: After Akbar acceded in 1556, the Mughal empire incorporated much of northern India and parts of the Deccan through conquest, marriage alliances and administrative reform. At courts in Fatehpur Sikri and Lahore he gathered Persian, Indian and Central Asian craftsmen, painters and scholars, encouraging translation and religious debate. This widened the revenue base and produced a multilingual court culture.

significance.zh: 阿克巴时期奠定了莫卧儿帝国行政与文化整合的基本模式。
significance.en: Akbar's reign established the basic pattern of Mughal administrative and cultural consolidation.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Art of the Mughals before 1600

editorialNotes.zh: 1556—1605为阿克巴在位期；艺术史来源侧重宫廷赞助与绘画，不能覆盖帝国全部税制与地方行政。
editorialNotes.en: 1556–1605 is Akbar's reign; the art-historical source emphasises court patronage and painting and does not cover the whole revenue or local administration.

summary.zh: 1557年4月30日黎明，西班牙总督比利亚格拉率军突袭马普切领袖莱夫扎茹设在马塔基托河畔树林间的营寨。此前莱夫扎茹曾击杀前任总督瓦尔迪维亚并进逼圣地亚哥。西班牙军夜袭得手，莱夫扎茹战死，马普切人对圣地亚哥的威胁解除，阿劳卡尼亚战争进入新的阶段。
summary.en: At dawn on 30 April 1557 the Spanish governor Francisco de Villagra surprised the fortified camp of the Mapuche toqui Lautaro between a wooded hill and the Mataquito River. Lautaro, who had killed the former governor Pedro de Valdivia and threatened Santiago, was killed in the attack, ending Mapuche designs on the Spanish capital.

significance.zh: 马塔基托之战击杀了马普切领袖莱夫扎茹，解除了马普切人对圣地亚哥的威胁，也报了瓦尔迪维亚阵亡之仇。
significance.en: Mataquito killed Lautaro, ended the Mapuche threat to Santiago and avenged the death of Pedro de Valdivia.

sources.title: Wikidata — Q1617667（实体声明与坐标来源，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.en: Both Wikipedia articles date the battle to 30 April 1557; the entry keeps year precision.

summary.zh: 1560年6月，东海道大名今川义元率大军进入尾张国，织田信长在暴雨中率少数亲兵突袭今川军本阵，今川义元阵亡。战后今川氏迅速衰落，织田信长转而扩张势力，逐步控制京都周边，为其日后主导日本政局奠定基础，此战也成为战国史上以寡击众的著名战例。
summary.en: In June 1560 the Imagawa warlord Yoshimoto marched into Owari province with a far larger army. Oda Nobunaga attacked his headquarters in a rainstorm with a small force and killed him. The Imagawa clan declined rapidly while Nobunaga expanded towards Kyoto, laying the base for his later dominance of central Japan.

significance.zh: 桶狭间之战是日本战国以寡击众的著名战例，也是织田信长崛起的起点。
significance.en: Okehazama is the classic case of a smaller force defeating a larger one in the Sengoku period and the starting point of Nobunaga's rise.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of Okehazama（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.en: The date is 12 June in the Gregorian calendar and the nineteenth day of the fifth month in the lunar calendar, and Imagawa's army is estimated at 25,000 to 45,000; this entry keeps year precision.

title.zh: 胡马雍陵与莫卧儿纪念建筑
title.en: Humayun's Tomb and Mughal commemorative architecture

summary.zh: 十六世纪六十年代，莫卧儿宫廷在德里为皇帝胡马雍营建陵墓，约1570年完成。陵园采用四分花园、水渠与居中穹顶的布局，由波斯与印度工匠共同建造，成为此后莫卧儿陵墓建筑的重要参照，也影响了泰姬陵一类纪念性建筑的空间组织。陵园在后世经历修缮与再利用。
summary.en: In the 1560s the Mughal court built a tomb for the emperor Humayun in Delhi, completed around 1570. Its charbagh garden, water channels and central dome were made by Persian and Indian craftsmen and became an important reference for later Mughal tombs, shaping the spatial organisation of monuments such as the Taj Mahal.

significance.zh: 胡马雍陵把波斯园林传统转化为莫卧儿纪念建筑的基本范式。
significance.en: Humayun's Tomb turned Persian garden traditions into a basic model for Mughal commemorative architecture.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Humayun's Tomb, Delhi

editorialNotes.zh: 来源以1560年代与约1570年概括建造与完成时间，本条沿用该概括，不指定动工的具体日期。
editorialNotes.en: The source summarises construction in the 1560s and completion around 1570; this entry follows that summary without assigning a precise start date.

summary.zh: 西班牙航海者找到从菲律宾横渡太平洋返回美洲的可行航路，随后发展出连接马尼拉与阿卡普尔科的大帆船贸易。中国丝绸、瓷器等亚洲商品与美洲白银在这一网络中交换，商人、船员和移民也跨海流动。马尼拉逐渐成为亚洲区域贸易与西班牙殖民世界相交的港口。
summary.en: Spanish navigators established a practicable Pacific return route from the Philippines to the Americas, enabling the Manila–Acapulco galleon trade. Asian goods, including Chinese silk and porcelain, were exchanged for American silver, while merchants, sailors and migrants crossed the ocean. Manila became a meeting point between Asian commercial networks and the Spanish colonial world.

significance.zh: 太平洋贸易把亚洲生产、美洲白银与欧洲殖民网络更紧密地联系起来。
significance.en: Pacific commerce connected Asian production, American silver and European colonial networks more closely.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Manila galleon trade

summary.zh: 1578年8月，葡萄牙国王塞巴斯蒂昂率军在北非的阿尔卡塞尔-基比尔附近与摩洛哥萨阿德王朝苏丹阿卜杜勒·马利克交战。葡萄牙军队在酷热中被诱入沼泽地带，塞巴斯蒂昂与两位争夺王位的对手均阵亡，史称三王之战。葡萄牙王统因此中断，两年后并入西班牙哈布斯堡王朝。
summary.en: In August 1578 King Sebastian of Portugal fought the Saadian sultan Abd al-Malik near Alcacer Quibir in North Africa. The Portuguese army was drawn into hot, marshy ground, and Sebastian and both rival claimants to the Moroccan throne died, giving the battle its name. The Portuguese succession collapsed and the kingdom passed to the Spanish Habsburgs two years later.

significance.zh: 三王之战终结了阿维什王朝，直接导致葡萄牙被西班牙联合统治六十年。
significance.en: The Battle of the Three Kings ended the Aviz dynasty and brought Portugal under Spanish rule for sixty years.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of Alcácer Quibir（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 三王战役（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.en: The date is given as 4 or 5 August, and the identification of Sebastian's body was long disputed; this entry keeps year precision.

summary.zh: 1589年7月17日，伊达政宗率军在陆奥国折上原（今福岛县猪苗代与磐梯一带）与芦名义广、佐竹义重联军交战。伊达军击破对手，芦名氏灭亡，政宗由此控制南陆奥大部，为日后称雄东北奠定基础。此役是伊达氏扩张过程中最关键的会战之一，也是战国后期东北势力重组的标志。
summary.en: On 17 July 1589 Date Masamune defeated the allied forces of Ashina Yoshihiro and Satake Yoshishige at Suriagehara in Mutsu Province, in what is now Fukushima Prefecture. The Ashina house was destroyed and Date took control of most of southern Mutsu, laying the base for his dominance of the north-east.

significance.zh: 折上原之战消灭芦名氏，使伊达政宗一举控制南陆奥，是其在东北扩张的决定性会战。
significance.en: Suriagehara destroyed the Ashina and gave Date Masamune control of southern Mutsu, deciding his expansion in the north-east.

title.zh: 摩洛哥入侵与桑海帝国衰落

summary.zh: 摩洛哥军队跨越撒哈拉沙漠，在通迪比击败桑海军队，随后进入尼日尔河沿岸的重要城市。远征依赖火器和精锐兵力，却难以在遥远的苏丹地区维持稳定控制。桑海中央权力瓦解后，地方政权重新组合，跨撒哈拉贸易、城市学术生活和区域政治关系都受到战争与长期动荡的冲击。
summary.en: A Moroccan army crossed the Sahara and defeated Songhai forces at Tondibi before occupying important Niger River towns. Firearms and experienced troops helped the expedition, but sustained control across such distances proved difficult. Songhai's central authority fragmented, local powers reorganized, and warfare disrupted trans-Saharan commerce, urban scholarship and regional political relationships.

significance.zh: 桑海的衰落改变了西非萨赫勒地区长期形成的政治与贸易格局。
significance.en: Songhai's decline transformed established political and commercial relationships across the western Sahel.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Moroccan invasion and Songhai’s decline

title.zh: 马尼拉刊印《基督教教义》
title.en: Doctrina Christiana is printed in Manila

summary.zh: 马尼拉刊印西班牙文与他加禄文《基督教教义》，以木版印刷传播宗教知识。他加禄语同时使用拉丁字母和本地文字，保留早期语言与书写传统的珍贵记录。书籍把传教、翻译和印刷技术结合起来，也反映殖民社会中本地读者、亚洲工艺和欧洲宗教机构之间的文化接触。
summary.en: A Spanish and Tagalog Doctrina Christiana was printed from woodblocks in Manila. Tagalog appeared in both Roman letters and a local script, preserving valuable evidence of early language and writing. The book joined missionary teaching, translation and printing and reflected cultural encounters among local readers, Asian technologies and European religious institutions.

significance.zh: 早期印本为研究菲律宾语言、文字与殖民时期知识传播留下重要实物。
significance.en: The early printed book preserves important evidence of Philippine writing and colonial knowledge transmission.

sources.title: Library of Congress — Doctrina Christiana, 1593

title.zh: 阿巴斯一世与伊斯法罕

summary.zh: 十六世纪九十年代，萨法维沙阿阿巴斯一世把都城从加兹温迁到伊斯法罕，围绕皇家广场营建清真寺、巴扎、宫殿与桥梁，并把新城区设为瓦克夫地产以支持宗教与公共设施。迁都使政治中心远离奥斯曼前线，同时加强了与印度洋和欧洲贸易的联系。伊斯法罕由此成为十七世纪西亚最大的城市之一。
summary.en: In the 1590s Shah Abbas I moved the Safavid capital from Qazvin to Isfahan, laying out mosques, bazaars, palaces and bridges around a royal square and endowing the new centre as waqf property. The move placed the court farther from the Ottoman frontier and strengthened links with Indian Ocean and European trade. Isfahan became one of the largest cities of seventeenth-century West Asia.

significance.zh: 伊斯法罕的营建把萨法维的政治、宗教与商业权力集中于新的都城。
significance.en: The building of Isfahan concentrated Safavid political, religious and commercial power in a new capital.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Iranica — Safavid dynasty

title.zh: 英国东印度公司获特许状
title.en: Charter of the English East India Company

summary.zh: 伊丽莎白一世向英国东印度公司颁发特许状，授权其经营与亚洲的贸易。公司起初通过商站、航运和同当地统治者谈判参与印度洋商业，后来逐渐拥有军队与征税权。商业组织、国家支持和武装扩张相互结合，使公司在十八世纪由贸易参与者转变为南亚重要的领土统治者。
summary.en: Elizabeth I granted a charter to the English East India Company for Asian trade. The company initially entered Indian Ocean commerce through trading posts, shipping and agreements with local rulers. State support and armed expansion later accompanied its commercial activities, and during the eighteenth century it acquired armies, revenue powers and extensive territorial authority in South Asia.

significance.zh: 特许公司成为欧洲商业资本与海外政治扩张结合的重要制度。
significance.en: The chartered company became a powerful institution linking European commerce with overseas political expansion.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Charter of the English East India Company

summary.zh: 1600年10月，德川家康率领的东军与石田三成等组成的西军在美浓国关原一带决战。西军部分将领临阵倒戈，东军在半日内取胜，三成被俘处死。此役确立了德川家康对全日本的支配地位，被视为战国时代结束与江户幕府两百六十余年统治的开端。
summary.en: In October 1600 the eastern army of Tokugawa Ieyasu defeated a western coalition led by Ishida Mitsunari at Sekigahara in Mino province. Several western commanders defected during the fighting, and the battle was decided within a day. The victory gave Ieyasu control of Japan and opened the long Tokugawa order.

significance.zh: 关原之战决定了日本近世政治秩序的归属，是江户幕府成立前最重要的会战。
significance.en: Sekigahara settled who would rule Japan and is the decisive battle before the Tokugawa shogunate.

title.zh: 曼加斯与罗伊·马塔的酋长权威
title.en: Mangaas and the chiefly authority of Roi Mata

summary.zh: 十七世纪初，瓦努阿图中部岛屿的酋长罗伊·马塔以曼加斯一带的居所与仪式空间行使权威。当地社会依靠芋田、渔猎与交换维持生计，酋长通过分配资源、主持仪式和联姻维系跨岛关系。罗伊·马塔死后被葬于勒勒帕岛，其头衔与传说延续至今，成为当地社会记忆的一部分。
summary.en: In the early seventeenth century the chief Roi Mata exercised authority from residences and ceremonial places around Mangaas in central Vanuatu. Communities lived from taro gardens, fishing and exchange, while the chief sustained inter-island relations through the distribution of resources, ritual and marriage. After his death he was buried on Lelepa, and his title and stories remain part of local memory.

significance.zh: 罗伊·马塔遗址记录了太平洋岛屿酋长制度与口述传统的结合。
significance.en: The Roi Mata sites record the combination of Pacific chiefly institutions and oral tradition.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Chief Roi Mata's Domain

title.zh: 廷巴克图手稿传统与十八世纪学术活动
title.en: Timbuktu's manuscript tradition and eighteenth-century scholarship

summary.zh: 十七至十八世纪，廷巴克图的家族图书馆持续抄写与收藏手稿，内容涵盖天文学、法律、算术、医学与商业契约。商队贸易带来的收入支持学者教学与书籍流通，部分天文和法律抄本明确记为十八世纪抄写。这些手稿说明撒哈拉以南非洲存在延续数百年的书写与学术传统。
summary.en: In the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries family libraries in Timbuktu continued to copy and collect manuscripts on astronomy, law, arithmetic, medicine and commercial agreements. Income from caravan trade supported teaching and the circulation of books; some astronomical and legal copies are explicitly dated to the eighteenth century.

significance.zh: 廷巴克图手稿表明西非城市拥有延续数百年的书写与学术网络。
significance.en: Timbuktu's manuscripts show that West African cities sustained centuries-long written scholarly networks.

sources.title: Library of Congress — Ancient Manuscripts from the Desert Libraries of Timbuktu

editorialNotes.en: The 1733 copy is one exhibited example, not the date of every manuscript, and the history of family libraries is not continuous or complete.

title.en: Foundation of the Dutch East India Company

summary.zh: 荷兰多个亚洲贸易公司合并为东印度公司，获得贸易垄断及缔约、筑堡和作战等权力。公司利用长期资本和跨洋组织网络扩大经营，在香料、纺织品和其他商品贸易中建立重要地位。商业活动与强制垄断、殖民战争和地方联盟相互结合，深刻影响东南亚及印度洋的经济政治关系。
summary.en: Several Dutch Asian trading ventures merged into the VOC, receiving monopoly privileges and powers to make treaties, build forts and wage war. Long-term capital and overseas organization supported its trade in spices, textiles and other goods. Commerce, coercive monopoly, colonial warfare and local alliances together transformed relationships across Southeast Asia and the Indian Ocean.

significance.zh: 东印度公司把股份资本、贸易网络与国家授权的武力结合成跨洋制度。
significance.en: The VOC combined joint-stock capital and commercial networks with state-authorized coercive power.

sources.title: Nationaal Archief — VOC, 1602–1800

summary.zh: 德川家康在关原战役后的权力重组中获任征夷大将军，以江户为中心建立幕府。德川家族与各藩大名构成等级化的统治体系，后续制度强化了对武士、城市与乡村的管理。持续的国内和平促进人口、农业、市场和出版文化发展，也形成了幕府晚期改革与危机的社会背景。
summary.en: After consolidating power following Sekigahara, Tokugawa Ieyasu became shogun and established his government at Edo. The Tokugawa house and regional lords formed a hierarchical political order, strengthened by later regulations over warriors, towns and villages. Prolonged domestic peace encouraged agriculture, markets and print culture, creating the social conditions of the later shogunate's reforms and crises.

significance.zh: 江户幕府开启了两个多世纪的政治稳定与社会经济转型。
significance.en: The Edo shogunate began more than two centuries of political stability and socioeconomic transformation.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Establishment of the Tokugawa shogunate

title.zh: 二条城与幕府在京都的权威
title.en: Nijō Castle and shogunal authority in Kyoto

summary.zh: 1603年，德川家康在京都营建二条城，并在此向朝廷与诸侯显示将军权威。此后二百余年，幕府通过驻京机构、城郭与仪式参与京都的政治生活，二条城既是将军的居所，也是幕府与宫廷交涉的场所。1867年，德川庆喜在此表明奉还大政的意向，幕府统治随之结束。
summary.en: In 1603 Tokugawa Ieyasu built Nijō Castle in Kyoto, using it to display shogunal authority before the court and lords. For more than two centuries the shogunate took part in the capital's political life through residences, fortifications and ceremony. In 1867 the castle hosted the declaration of intent to return governing power to the emperor, ending shogunal rule.

significance.zh: 二条城把幕府权力与京都宫廷的长期共存凝固在建筑与仪式之中。
significance.en: Nijō Castle materialises the long coexistence of shogunal power and the Kyoto court in architecture and ceremony.

sources.title: City of Kyoto / Nijō-jo Castle — Chronology

editorialNotes.zh: 1603年为现二之丸区域完成之年；1867年为表明奉还大政意向之年，政权移交在此后数月完成。
editorialNotes.en: 1603 is the completion year of the present Ninomaru area; 1867 is the year the intent to return power was declared, with the transfer completed in the following months.

summary.zh: 伽利略改进望远镜并将其用于天文观察，发现月球表面起伏、木星卫星等现象，随后发表《星际信使》。这些观测削弱了天体完美无瑕和一切绕地球运行的传统观念。仪器制造、公开出版与争论共同改变了科学证据的传播方式，日心学说也由此获得新的观测支持。
summary.en: Galileo improved the telescope and turned it toward the sky, observing the Moon's uneven surface and satellites around Jupiter before publishing Sidereus Nuncius. These findings challenged ideas of perfect heavens and universal Earth-centred motion. Instrument making, publication and controversy changed how evidence circulated, while new observations strengthened arguments for heliocentric astronomy.

significance.zh: 望远镜使可重复的仪器观测成为近代天文学的重要证据来源。
significance.en: The telescope made repeatable instrumental observation a central source of evidence in modern astronomy.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Galileo’s telescopic observations

summary.zh: 1614年11月26日，大坂冬之阵期间，上杉景胜率德川方军队进攻大坂城东北鴫野村的丰臣方阵地。丰臣方由井上赖次率两千人据三重栅栏防守，栅栏被攻破，井上阵亡。大野治长率一万两千人来援并反击，上杉方以铁炮齐射稳住阵脚，丰臣军最终撤回大坂城。
summary.en: On 26 November 1614, during the winter campaign of the Siege of Osaka, Uesugi Kagekatsu's Tokugawa force attacked the Toyotomi position at Shigino village north-east of Osaka Castle. The defenders under Inoue Yoritsugu held three lines of fences with two thousand men but were overrun and their commander killed. A relief force under Ono Harunaga counter-attacked before withdrawing.

significance.zh: 鴫野之战与今福之战同日发生，是大坂冬之阵初期德川方压制大坂外围据点的关键交战。
significance.en: Fought on the same day as Imafuku, Shigino was an early Tokugawa success in clearing the approaches to Osaka Castle.

summary.zh: 波希米亚的政治与宗教冲突引发战争，神圣罗马帝国诸邦和多个欧洲强国相继卷入。天主教与新教的对立同王朝利益交织，军队征粮、疾病和人口流离使中欧社会遭受严重破坏。战争经过多次联盟重组，最终由威斯特伐利亚和约结束主要战事，并重新安排帝国内部权利与欧洲力量关系。
summary.en: Political and religious conflict in Bohemia expanded into war involving imperial territories and major European powers. Confessional divisions intersected with dynastic ambitions, while military requisitioning, disease and displacement devastated central European communities. Changing alliances prolonged the conflict until the Peace of Westphalia ended its principal hostilities and revised imperial rights and European power relationships.

significance.zh: 战争显示教派冲突与国家竞争的交织，并推动新的欧洲外交安排。
significance.en: The war intertwined confessional conflict with state rivalry and prompted new diplomatic arrangements in Europe.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Thirty Years’ War

title.zh: 贡德尔成为埃塞俄比亚固定都城
title.en: Gondar becomes an Ethiopian royal capital

summary.zh: 法西利德皇帝在贡德尔建立固定都城，改变埃塞俄比亚王廷长期迁移营地的惯例。皇宫、教堂、修道院和行政建筑在此陆续兴建，形成法西尔盖比建筑群。当地工艺与外来建筑影响相互结合，绘画、音乐和文学随宫廷及宗教活动发展，使贡德尔成为十七、十八世纪的重要政治与文化中心。
summary.en: Emperor Fasilides established a permanent capital at Gondar after a long tradition of mobile royal camps. Palaces, churches, monasteries and administrative buildings formed the Fasil Ghebbi complex. Local craftsmanship interacted with external architectural influences, while painting, music and literature flourished around court and religious life, making Gondar a major seventeenth- and eighteenth-century cultural centre.

significance.zh: 固定都城推动了埃塞俄比亚宫廷文化、建筑与国家行政的集中发展。
significance.en: A permanent capital concentrated Ethiopian court culture, architecture and government.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Fasil Ghebbi, Gondar Region

title.zh: 沙贾汗纳巴德与红堡营建
title.en: The building of Shahjahanabad and the Red Fort

summary.zh: 1639年，莫卧儿皇帝沙贾汗在德里旧城以北营建新的都城沙贾汗纳巴德，宫殿城堡红堡于1648年前后完成。红堡沿雅穆纳河西岸展开，亭阁、水渠与花园结合波斯、帖木儿和印度建筑传统；宫堡与清真寺、集市共同构成帝国都城。此后德里多次经历政权更替，红堡始终是权力象征。
summary.en: In 1639 the Mughal emperor Shah Jahan began a new capital, Shahjahanabad, north of earlier Delhi, and the palace-fortress known as the Red Fort was completed around 1648. Set beside the Yamuna, its pavilions, water channels and gardens combined Persian, Timurid and Indian traditions, while mosques and bazaars formed the imperial city around it.

significance.zh: 沙贾汗纳巴德集中体现了莫卧儿都城规划与建筑综合能力。
significance.en: Shahjahanabad concentrates Mughal achievement in capital planning and architectural synthesis.

sources.title: Ministry of Culture, Government of India / Press Information Bureau — Red Fort, Delhi: Backgrounder
UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Red Fort Complex

editorialNotes.zh: 1639—1648为红堡建造期；此后红堡经过改建并长期作为军事设施使用。
editorialNotes.en: 1639–1648 is the Red Fort's construction period; it was later altered and long used as a military installation.

summary.zh: 李自成军进入北京后，明朝中央政权崩溃；清军随即通过山海关，并在击败大顺军后占领北京。顺治帝迁都北京，清朝开始以新的政治中心统治中国。此后仍经历对南明、地方抵抗与其他势力的长期战争，军事征服、制度继承和满汉精英合作共同塑造了清代国家。
summary.en: After Li Zicheng's forces entered Beijing and the Ming central government collapsed, Qing troops passed through Shanhai Pass and defeated the Shun army. The Shunzhi emperor made Beijing his capital. Subsequent campaigns against Southern Ming regimes and other opponents extended Qing control, combining conquest, inherited institutions and cooperation among Manchu and Han elites.

significance.zh: 清朝取得北京是明清鼎革的关键节点，并开启新的帝国整合过程。
significance.en: The Qing capture of Beijing marked a decisive stage in dynastic transition and imperial consolidation.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Qing occupation of Beijing

summary.zh: 经过长期谈判，明斯特与奥斯纳布吕克签订的一系列和约结束了三十年战争的主要冲突。和约调整神圣罗马帝国诸邦的权利与宗教安排，承认荷兰和瑞士的独立地位，并重新分配部分领土。参与谈判的多国使节也展示了持续外交协商在处理复杂国际争端中的作用。
summary.en: Treaties negotiated at Münster and Osnabrück ended the principal conflicts of the Thirty Years' War. They revised the rights and religious arrangements of imperial territories, recognized Dutch and Swiss independence, and redistributed some lands. Multilateral negotiations also demonstrated the role of sustained diplomacy in settling disputes involving overlapping political and confessional interests.

significance.zh: 和约重整了中欧政治秩序，并成为欧洲外交史的重要参照。
significance.en: The settlements reorganized central European politics and became an important reference point in diplomatic history.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Peace of Westphalia

title.zh: 清代宫廷绘画与帝国文化整合
title.en: Qing court painting and imperial cultural consolidation

summary.zh: 十七世纪后期至十八世纪，清廷通过画院、南巡与宫廷收藏组织绘画创作，皇帝、满洲贵族、汉族文人与欧洲传教士画家共同参与。宫廷绘画既记录典礼、战功与巡幸，也吸收文人山水和西洋透视技法，成为多民族帝国展示秩序与自我叙述的工具。这些作品同时也限定了后人观看清帝国的视角。
summary.en: From the late seventeenth to the eighteenth century the Qing court organised painting through the academy, imperial tours and collections, bringing together the emperor, Manchu nobles, Han literati and European missionary artists. Court pictures recorded ceremonies, campaigns and journeys while combining literati landscape with Western perspective, serving as instruments of imperial self-presentation.

significance.zh: 宫廷绘画显示清代如何用图像整合多民族帝国的政治秩序。
significance.en: Court painting shows how the Qing used images to integrate the political order of a multi-ethnic empire.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — The Qing Dynasty (1644–1911): Painting

editorialNotes.zh: 1662—1795覆盖康熙后期至乾隆末年的主要赞助期；绘画赞助集中于宫廷与精英，不能代表清代全部视觉文化。
editorialNotes.en: 1662–1795 covers the main patronage period from the later Kangxi to the end of Qianlong; patronage centred on court and elite circles and does not represent all Qing visual culture.

title.zh: 牛顿发表《自然哲学的数学原理》

summary.zh: 牛顿出版《自然哲学的数学原理》，以运动定律和万有引力说明地面物体与天体的运动。他把数学推导、天文观测和实验问题联系起来，解释行星轨道、潮汐等现象。著作经后续研究者阐释与扩展，形成可供计算和预测的力学体系，深刻影响物理学、工程与启蒙时期的自然观。
summary.en: Newton's Principia used laws of motion and universal gravitation to explain terrestrial and celestial movement within one mathematical framework. It connected mathematical reasoning with observations and physical problems, including planetary orbits and tides. Later researchers clarified and extended its methods, creating a predictive mechanics that deeply influenced physics, engineering and Enlightenment views of nature.

significance.zh: 统一的数学力学使自然现象能够得到系统解释与定量预测。
significance.en: A unified mathematical mechanics enabled systematic explanations and quantitative predictions of natural phenomena.

sources.title: Library of Congress — Newton, Principia, 1687

title.zh: 英国光荣革命与权利法案
title.en: Glorious Revolution and Bill of Rights

summary.zh: 威廉率军进入英格兰，詹姆斯二世出逃，议会随后拥立威廉与玛丽为共同君主。次年的《权利法案》限制王权，并确认议会在征税、立法和军队事务中的重要地位。政权转换在不列颠及爱尔兰产生不同后果，宗教归属和继承权仍引发战争，而议会制度则获得更稳定的政治基础。
summary.en: William's intervention in England led to James II's flight and Parliament's offer of the crown to William and Mary. The following year's Bill of Rights limited royal powers and strengthened Parliament's position in taxation, legislation and military affairs. The transition had different consequences across Britain and Ireland, where religious and succession conflicts continued.

significance.zh: 君主与议会的关系发生持久调整，为英国宪政发展奠定关键基础。
significance.en: The settlement durably altered relations between monarchy and Parliament and advanced British constitutional development.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Glorious Revolution and Bill of Rights

title.zh: 锡克教卡尔萨共同体形成

summary.zh: 古鲁戈宾德·辛格在阿南德普尔建立卡尔萨共同体，以入教仪式、共同纪律和外在标志加强锡克教徒的集体认同。信仰实践同维护群体尊严与自我防卫结合，挑战既有等级观念。卡尔萨此后经历与邻近政权的冲突，并在旁遮普的宗教生活、军事组织和政治形成中发挥深远作用。
summary.en: Guru Gobind Singh established the Khalsa at Anandpur, strengthening Sikh collective identity through initiation, shared discipline and visible symbols. Religious commitment combined with communal dignity and self-defence and challenged inherited hierarchies. The Khalsa later confronted neighbouring powers and deeply influenced religious life, military organization and political formation in Punjab.

significance.zh: 卡尔萨为锡克教共同体提供了持久的组织、伦理与身份基础。
significance.en: The Khalsa provided an enduring organizational, ethical and identity framework for Sikh communities.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Quoit (Chakra), Sikh tradition

summary.zh: 十八世纪初，奥塞·图图领导的阿散蒂势力把多个阿坎政治共同体联合起来，并从库马西向外扩展。黄金贸易、军事组织与共同仪式支持王权，宫廷吸收不同地区的传统，发展出织物、金饰和权杖等鲜明艺术。阿散蒂逐渐成为西非内陆的重要强国，在区域贸易和外交中发挥持续影响。
summary.en: Around the beginning of the eighteenth century, Osei Tutu's Asante polity united several Akan communities and expanded from Kumasi. Gold commerce, military organization and shared ritual supported royal authority. The court adopted traditions from across its territories and developed distinctive textiles, goldwork and regalia, becoming an influential centre of West African politics and culture.

significance.zh: 阿散蒂的兴起说明非洲国家建设、商业网络与艺术创造之间的密切联系。
significance.en: Asante's rise illustrates the close relationship among African state-building, commerce and artistic production.

sources.title: The Metropolitan Museum of Art — Art of the Asante Kingdom

editorialNotes.zh: 约1700年用于标示阿散蒂在十七世纪末至十八世纪初的政治整合，国家形成经历了持续的联盟与战争过程。
editorialNotes.en: Around 1700 marks Asante’s political consolidation across the late seventeenth and early eighteenth centuries, through a continuing process of alliance and warfare.

title.zh: 加勒比甘蔗种植园经济的扩张
title.en: The expansion of the Caribbean sugar plantation economy

summary.zh: 18至20世纪，甘蔗种植与制糖成为加勒比岛屿经济的主体，岛上大片土地用于蔗田与糖厂。种植园的主要劳动力在奴隶制废除前是被奴役的非洲人，此后则来自印度、中国、葡萄牙等地的契约劳工。加勒比糖业一度供应世界市场的大部分食糖，其利润与奴隶制、殖民贸易紧密相连。
summary.en: In the eighteenth to twentieth centuries sugar cane and refining dominated Caribbean island economies, with much land given to cane fields and mills. The main labour force was enslaved Africans until the abolition of slavery, after which indentured labourers came from India, China, Portugal and elsewhere. Caribbean sugar supplied most of the world market at times, its profits bound up with slavery and colonial trade.

significance.zh: 加勒比糖业把种植园、奴隶制与全球消费市场连接为一体，是近代世界经济的核心案例。
significance.en: Caribbean sugar linked plantations, slavery and global consumer markets, a central case in the making of the modern world economy.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Sugar plantations in the Caribbean（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 本条用1700—1900年概括种植园经济的全盛与转型期；不同岛屿的兴衰年代差异较大。
editorialNotes.en: The 1700–1900 range covers the plantation economy's peak and transformation; individual islands rose and declined at different times.

title.en: The War of the Spanish Succession

summary.zh: 西班牙王位继承战争（1701—1714）因1700年卡洛斯二世去世无嗣而爆发，法国支持的安茹公爵腓力与奥地利哈布斯堡支持的查理大公争夺王位，英国、荷兰等组成大同盟对抗法国。战争以《乌得勒支和约》等结束，波旁家族获得西班牙王位，欧洲均势与海外殖民地格局随之调整。
summary.en: The War of the Spanish Succession (1701–1714) broke out after Charles II of Spain died childless in 1700, with Philip of Anjou backed by France and Archduke Charles by the Austrian Habsburgs while Britain, the Dutch and others formed a Grand Alliance against France. It ended with the treaties of Utrecht and related agreements: the Bourbons kept the Spanish throne and the European balance and overseas empires were rearranged.

significance.zh: 这场战争确立了18世纪欧洲的均势格局，并把海外贸易与殖民地权利纳入和约安排。
significance.en: The war fixed the eighteenth-century European balance and brought overseas trade and colonial rights into treaty settlements.

sources.title: Wikipedia — War of the Spanish Succession（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.en: Related conflicts included the Great Northern War and Queen Anne's War; this entry covers the Spanish succession main line only.

title.zh: 斋浦尔建城与18世纪拉杰普特政治
title.en: The founding of Jaipur and eighteenth-century Rajput politics

summary.zh: 安梅尔土邦王公萨瓦伊·贾伊·辛格二世于1727年规划并营建新都斋浦尔，以网格街道、市场与水利设施组成有规划的城市，1743年他去世前城市格局基本成形。他早年名义上仍是莫卧儿帝国的封臣，同时在天文观测与建筑上留下重要成果。
summary.en: Sawai Jai Singh II of Amber planned and built the new capital of Jaipur from 1727, laying out a grid of streets, markets and waterworks; the city's form was largely established before his death in 1743. Nominally still a Mughal vassal in his early years, he also left major achievements in astronomy and architecture.

significance.zh: 斋浦尔是南亚少见的按规划新建的18世纪都城，反映莫卧儿秩序瓦解后地方政权的组织能力。
significance.en: Jaipur is a rare planned eighteenth-century South Asian capital and shows the organisational capacity of regional powers as Mughal order fragmented.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Jai Singh II（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 1727年为建城之年，1743年为王公去世之年；本条用1727—1743表示城市规划与营建期，不表示城市在此期间才有人居住。
editorialNotes.en: 1727 is the year the city was founded and 1743 the year the ruler died; the range marks the planning and building phase and does not imply the site was previously uninhabited.

summary.zh: 1747年，艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼在坎大哈建立杜兰尼帝国，被认为是现代阿富汗国家的起点。帝国鼎盛时统治今阿富汗、巴基斯坦大部与伊朗东北部、印度西北部部分地区，与奥斯曼帝国并列为18世纪后期重要的伊斯兰帝国；1772年艾哈迈德沙去世后扩张放缓。
summary.en: In 1747 Ahmad Shah Durrani founded the Durrani Empire at Kandahar, widely regarded as the starting point of the modern Afghan state. At its height it ruled present-day Afghanistan, much of Pakistan and parts of north-eastern Iran and north-western India, ranking with the Ottoman Empire among the major Islamic empires of the later eighteenth century; expansion slowed after his death in 1772.

significance.zh: 杜兰尼帝国把阿富汗高原的部落力量整合为区域性帝国，其政治遗产影响至今。
significance.en: The Durrani Empire united Afghan tribal forces into a regional empire whose political legacy persists.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Durrani Empire（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 1747年为建国年，1772年为艾哈迈德沙去世年；帝国此后延续至19世纪初，本条只覆盖其扩张期。
editorialNotes.en: 1747 is the founding year and 1772 the year Ahmad Shah died; the empire continued into the early nineteenth century, and this entry covers its expansion phase only.

summary.zh: 狄德罗、达朗贝尔及众多作者开始出版法国《百科全书》，系统汇集科学、技艺、哲学和日常生产知识。文章与图版既介绍学术成果，也赋予工匠经验更高地位。出版过程遭遇审查与禁令，编者仍持续推进工程，使知识分类、理性批判和公共讨论成为启蒙运动的重要实践。
summary.en: Diderot, d'Alembert and numerous contributors began publishing the Encyclopédie, collecting knowledge of science, crafts, philosophy and production. Its essays and illustrations presented scholarship alongside artisans' expertise. Despite censorship and prohibitions, the editors continued the enterprise, turning the organization of knowledge, rational criticism and public discussion into central practices of the Enlightenment.

significance.zh: 《百科全书》扩大了知识的社会传播，并促进对传统权威的公开讨论。
significance.en: The Encyclopédie broadened the circulation of knowledge and public debate about inherited authority.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Publication of the Encyclopédie

summary.zh: 1755年6月3日至16日，蒙克顿中校率英军从劳伦斯堡出发围攻希格内克托地峡的博塞茹尔堡，法军小规模驻军在炮击后投降。英军由此控制地峡，切断魁北克与路易斯堡之间的联系，并随即开始驱逐阿卡迪亚居民，阿卡迪亚人被大批迁往英属北美各地。
summary.en: From 3 to 16 June 1755 a British force under Lieutenant-Colonel Robert Monckton besieged Fort Beausejour on the Isthmus of Chignecto and its small French garrison surrendered after bombardment. Britain thereby controlled the isthmus, cut the link between Quebec and Louisbourg and began the deportation of the Acadians.

significance.zh: 博塞茹尔堡之战结束了勒卢特尔神父之战，并直接引出对阿卡迪亚人的大规模驱逐。
significance.en: Fort Beausejour ended Father Le Loutre's War and led directly to the mass deportation of the Acadians.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of Fort Beauséjour（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 博塞茹爾堡之戰（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 围攻起止日期与法军投降时间各来源略有差异，守军人数约一百五十至二百人；本条只保留年份精度。
editorialNotes.en: Sources differ slightly on the siege dates and the surrender, and the garrison numbered about 150 to 200; this entry keeps year precision.

summary.zh: 1755年7月9日，布拉多克少将率英军向杜肯堡进军，在莫农加希拉河畔遭法国与加拿大部队及原住民联军伏击。英军以线式队形在林地中陷入混乱，布拉多克重伤身亡，远征失败。此役使俄亥俄河谷的战事进一步升级，英军此后改以更谨慎的方式推进。
summary.en: On 9 July 1755 General Edward Braddock's British force marching on Fort Duquesne was ambushed on the Monongahela by French and Canadian troops with Native American allies. Linear formations broke down in the woods, Braddock was mortally wounded and the expedition collapsed. The defeat escalated the contest for the Ohio valley.

significance.zh: 莫农加希拉之战使英军在北美开局受挫，并暴露了欧洲线式战术在北美林地的局限。
significance.en: The Monongahela checked the British opening campaign in North America and exposed the limits of European linear tactics in woodland.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of the Monongahela（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 莫農加希拉戰役（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 法方兵力约九百人且多为原住民战士，英军约一千三百人，双方伤亡数字各来源不一；本条只保留年份精度。
editorialNotes.en: The French force of about 900 was mostly Native American warriors and the British numbered about 1,300, with casualty figures varying by source; this entry keeps year precision.

summary.zh: 欧洲列强围绕领土、殖民地和商业利益展开战争，战事延伸到北美、加勒比海、南亚及海上航路。英国与法国的殖民竞争和普鲁士同欧洲邻国的冲突相互连接，地方盟友也深刻影响战局。战后英国海外地位增强，各国战争债务和殖民治理压力则为随后数十年的改革与革命积累矛盾。
summary.en: European powers fought over territory, colonies and commercial interests in conflicts reaching North America, the Caribbean, South Asia and maritime routes. Anglo-French colonial rivalry intersected with Prussia's struggles against European neighbours, while local allies shaped campaigns. Britain emerged stronger overseas, but wartime debts and colonial tensions created pressures that fed subsequent reforms and revolutions.

significance.zh: 多洲战场之间的联系显示帝国竞争已经形成紧密的全球体系。
significance.en: The connected campaigns revealed how imperial competition had become a global system.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Seven Years’ War

summary.zh: 英国东印度公司军队在普拉西击败孟加拉纳瓦布西拉杰·乌德·达乌拉。米尔·贾法尔等人的背离及公司参与的政治交易，对结果具有决定性影响。胜利使公司能够干预孟加拉统治，并获得重要财政资源；此后进一步战争和征税权扩张，把贸易公司推向领土统治者的位置。
summary.en: East India Company forces defeated Bengal's nawab, Siraj al-Dawlah, at Plassey. Defections and political agreements involving Mir Jafar were decisive to the result. Victory enabled the company to influence Bengal's government and obtain substantial resources; subsequent wars and revenue rights transformed its position from commercial actor toward territorial ruler.

significance.zh: 普拉西成为东印度公司建立南亚殖民权力的重要转折点。
significance.en: Plassey marked a major turn in the company's construction of colonial power in South Asia.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Battle of Plassey

summary.zh: 十八世纪后期，英国纺织生产、煤炭开采、蒸汽动力和机械制造相互促进，工厂逐渐扩大规模。生产集中改变了劳动节奏和城乡人口分布，也依赖贸易网络、资本积累与资源供应。工业化带来产量增长和新技术，同时伴随危险劳动、贫困与污染，后来扩展到欧洲其他地区和世界各地。
summary.en: From the later eighteenth century, British textiles, coal mining, steam power and machine making reinforced one another as factories expanded. Concentrated production changed working rhythms and settlement patterns, drawing on trade, capital and resources. Industrialization increased output and technical capacity while generating dangerous labour conditions, poverty and pollution, before spreading to other regions.

significance.zh: 机器生产和化石能源逐渐改变了全球经济增长与人类环境的关系。
significance.en: Mechanized production and fossil energy transformed economic growth and humanity's relationship with the environment.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Industrial Revolution in Britain

editorialNotes.zh: 1760—1840年是叙述英国早期工业化时常用的分期。不同产业和地区的转变速度各异，工业化也在此后继续扩展。
editorialNotes.en: 1760–1840 is a conventional period for Britain’s early industrialization. Industries and regions changed at different speeds, and industrialization continued afterward.

summary.zh: 1761年1月，艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼率阿富汗军队在帕尼帕特击败马拉塔帝国大军，马拉塔方面伤亡惨重。此役重创马拉塔向北印度扩张的势头，暂缓了其取代莫卧儿成为次大陆主导力量的进程，也为英国东印度公司在孟加拉的扩张留出空间，马拉塔联盟内部的裂痕此后加深。
summary.en: In January 1761 Ahmad Shah Durrani's Afghan army defeated a large Maratha force at Panipat. The defeat checked Maratha expansion into northern India and delayed their replacement of the Mughals as the leading power of the subcontinent, leaving room for the British East India Company in Bengal.

significance.zh: 第三次帕尼帕特重创马拉塔势力，改变了十八世纪中叶印度次大陆的力量对比。
significance.en: The third Panipat crippled Maratha power and shifted the balance in mid-eighteenth-century India.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Third Battle of Panipat（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）
维基百科 — 第三次帕尼帕特之戰（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 双方兵力与伤亡数字在各方记载中差异极大，本条采用1761年的年份精度，不采信任何单一数字。
editorialNotes.en: Troop and casualty figures vary enormously between accounts; this entry keeps year precision and adopts no single figure.

summary.zh: 1764年10月，英国东印度公司军队在孟加拉的布克萨尔击败莫卧儿皇帝沙阿·阿拉姆二世、阿瓦德纳瓦布与孟加拉纳瓦布组成的联军。战后签订的《阿拉哈巴德条约》使公司获得孟加拉、比哈尔与奥里萨的迪万尼权，即税收征收权，英国由此从商业势力转变为北印度实际统治者。
summary.en: In October 1764 the army of the British East India Company defeated a coalition of the Mughal emperor Shah Alam II and the nawabs of Awadh and Bengal at Buxar. The Treaty of Allahabad then granted the Company the diwani, the right to collect revenue in Bengal, Bihar and Orissa, turning a trader into the ruler of northern India.

significance.zh: 布克萨尔把孟加拉的税收权交给东印度公司，是英国在印度建立殖民统治的关键一步。
significance.en: Buxar handed Bengal's revenues to the East India Company and opened British colonial rule in India.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Battle of Buxar（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.en: Troop and casualty figures differ between accounts and the treaties were concluded in two stages in 1765; this entry keeps year precision.

title.zh: 库克考察澳大利亚东海岸

summary.zh: 库克率奋进号沿澳大利亚东海岸航行，绘制海图并采集自然标本，随后为英国提出领土主张。航行属于更广泛的太平洋科学考察与帝国竞争，也涉及与原住民的接触和冲突。形成的海图和报告为后来的英国殖民计划提供知识基础，沿岸原住民的土地与生活此后受到深刻影响。
summary.en: James Cook sailed along Australia's eastern coast in the Endeavour, mapping shores and collecting specimens before claiming territory for Britain. The voyage combined Pacific scientific investigation with imperial competition and encounters with Indigenous communities. Its charts and reports informed later British colonization, which profoundly affected Indigenous lands and ways of life.

significance.zh: 考察把科学知识、航海能力与英国在太平洋的殖民扩张联系起来。
significance.en: The voyage linked scientific knowledge and navigation with British colonial expansion in the Pacific.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — Cook claims Australia

summary.zh: 北美十三个殖民地的代表通过《独立宣言》，宣布脱离英国，并以自然权利和人民同意论证新政治秩序。声明出现在已经展开的独立战争之中，军事胜利与国际援助随后巩固了独立。宣言的平等语言广泛流传，也被后来的废奴、妇女权利和民权运动用于挑战现实中的排斥。
summary.en: Representatives of thirteen British colonies adopted the Declaration of Independence, invoking natural rights and government by consent. Issued during an ongoing war, the declaration was followed by military struggle and international assistance that secured independence. Its language of equality circulated widely and later supplied arguments for abolition, women's rights and civil-rights movements.

significance.zh: 宣言将独立诉求与普遍权利语言结合，成为现代政治思想的重要文本。
significance.en: The declaration connected independence with universal rights and became a major text of modern political thought.

sources.title: US National Archives — Declaration of Independence

summary.zh: 1785年1月20日，西山军将领阮惠在越南南部的沥涔与吹蔑两段河道设伏，以水军诱敌深入，围歼入侵的暹罗军队。暹罗军几乎全军覆没，残部退往柬埔寨。此役挫败了暹罗干涉越南南部的企图，为西山朝统一越南奠定基础，被越南史书列为重大胜利。
summary.en: On 20 January 1785 the Tay Son commander Nguyen Hue ambushed a Siamese army in the Rach Gam and Xoai Mut reaches of the Tien River in southern Vietnam, luring the fleet into a prepared trap. The Siamese force was almost annihilated and its survivors fled to Cambodia; the victory ended Siamese intervention in the south.

significance.zh: 沥涔吹蔑之战歼灭暹罗干涉军，为西山朝统一越南扫清外部障碍，是越南史上著名的水战胜利。
significance.en: Rach Gam-Xoai Mut destroyed the Siamese intervention force, cleared the way for Tay Son unification and became a celebrated naval victory in Vietnamese history.

sources.title: Wikidata — Q1047091（实体声明与坐标来源，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

title.en: First Fleet arrives at Sydney Cove

summary.zh: 第一舰队把囚犯、军人和其他殖民者运往澳大利亚，在悉尼湾建立英国定居点。新南威尔士殖民地逐渐发展出强制劳动、土地占有和对外补给体系。殖民定居与疾病传播压迫当地原住民社会，并引发长期的抵抗与边疆冲突，澳大利亚的近代国家形成由此进入新的阶段。
summary.en: The First Fleet brought convicts, soldiers and other settlers to Australia and established a British settlement at Sydney Cove. New South Wales developed around coerced labour, land appropriation and overseas supplies. Settlement and introduced diseases placed Indigenous communities under severe pressure, producing resistance and prolonged frontier conflict as colonial Australia took shape.

significance.zh: 悉尼殖民地成为英国在澳大利亚扩张的起点，也开启持续的土地与权利冲突。
significance.en: Sydney became a base for British expansion and enduring conflicts over Indigenous land and rights.

sources.title: National Museum of Australia — The First Fleet arrives at Sydney Cove

summary.zh: 财政危机促使法国召开三级会议，代表权争议很快扩大为对旧制度的挑战。攻占巴士底狱、废除封建特权和《人权与公民权宣言》相继出现，革命随后经历共和国、恐怖统治和战争。国家主权、法律平等与公民身份成为政治争论中心，社会动员也改变了欧洲及大西洋世界。
summary.en: France's fiscal crisis brought the Estates-General together, and disputes over representation became a challenge to the old regime. The fall of the Bastille, abolition of feudal privileges and Declaration of the Rights of Man were followed by republican government, the Terror and war. Sovereignty, legal equality and citizenship became central questions across the Atlantic world.

significance.zh: 法国大革命重塑了现代公民政治，也展示了革命动员的复杂后果。
significance.en: The French Revolution reshaped modern citizenship and demonstrated the far-reaching consequences of revolutionary mobilization.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — French Revolution

summary.zh: 圣多明各被奴役者发动起义，争取自由的斗争与法国革命、殖民战争及种族等级冲突交织。杜桑·卢维杜尔等领导人建立新的政治力量，后来德萨林领导的军队击败法军。海地于一八〇四年宣布独立，结束当地奴隶制和法国殖民统治，却面临国际孤立及沉重的经济压力。
summary.en: Enslaved people in Saint-Domingue launched an uprising that intersected with the French Revolution, colonial warfare and racial hierarchies. Leaders including Toussaint Louverture built new political forces, and armies under Dessalines eventually defeated the French. Haiti declared independence in 1804, ending slavery and French rule while confronting international isolation and severe economic pressures.

significance.zh: 海地革命证明被奴役者能够推翻殖民奴隶制度，并震动整个大西洋世界。
significance.en: Haiti's revolution overturned a colonial slave system and reverberated across the Atlantic world.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Haitian Revolution

title.zh: 黑人移民在弗里敦建立新社区
title.en: Black settlers establish a community at Freetown

summary.zh: 一千余名来自新斯科舍的黑人移民抵达塞拉利昂，参与建立弗里敦。他们中许多人曾在北美争取自由，却在战后生活中遭遇歧视与土地承诺落空。移民带来宗教、语言和自治期待，与当地社会及后来获释者共同塑造新的社区，弗里敦由此成为黑人大西洋迁徙史的重要节点。
summary.en: More than a thousand Black settlers from Nova Scotia arrived in Sierra Leone and helped establish Freetown. Many had sought freedom in North America but encountered discrimination and unfulfilled land promises. Their religious practices, language and aspirations for self-government interacted with local societies and later freed arrivals, making the city a major centre of Black Atlantic migration.

significance.zh: 弗里敦的形成连接了奴隶制、解放诉求和跨大西洋黑人社会的历史。
significance.en: Freetown's formation connected slavery, emancipation and the history of Black Atlantic communities.

sources.title: Government of Nova Scotia — African Heritage Month Narratives: Week Three

title.zh: 詹纳开展牛痘接种实验

summary.zh: 爱德华·詹纳依据挤奶工感染牛痘后较少患天花的观察，开展牛痘接种实验，并在之后发表研究结果。接种方法经医师、国家机构与地方网络逐渐传播，降低了天花带来的威胁。早期实践的风险、材料质量与公众信任也持续推动接种技术和公共卫生制度的改进。
summary.en: Edward Jenner tested cowpox inoculation after observing that dairy workers who contracted cowpox appeared protected against smallpox. Publication helped the practice spread through physicians, state institutions and local networks. Vaccination reduced smallpox's threat, while questions about safety, the quality of vaccine material and public trust shaped improvements in technique and public-health organization.

significance.zh: 牛痘接种为预防性免疫和后来全球消灭天花奠定了实践基础。
significance.en: Cowpox vaccination provided a practical foundation for preventive immunization and the later eradication of smallpox.

sources.title: World Health Organization — Smallpox

summary.zh: 1798年7月，拿破仑率法国东方军团在开罗附近的因巴拜与穆拉德贝伊率领的马穆鲁克军队交战。法军以师级方阵抵挡马穆鲁克骑兵冲锋，并以炮火与步兵火力取胜。此役使法国短暂控制埃及，也开启了欧洲对埃及的系统性考古与学术考察，随军学者随后记录了当地文物与地理。
summary.en: In July 1798 Napoleon's Army of the Orient fought the Mamluk forces of Murad Bey at Imbaba near Cairo. French divisional squares withstood the Mamluk cavalry charges and broke them with artillery and infantry fire. The victory gave France brief control of Egypt and opened a period of systematic European archaeology and scholarship there.

significance.zh: 金字塔战役确立了法国对埃及的短期占领，也把埃及古物带入欧洲学术视野。
significance.en: The Battle of the Pyramids established France's brief hold on Egypt and brought its antiquities into European scholarship.

summary.zh: 1800年5月3日，莫罗指挥的法军与克雷统率的奥军在施托卡赫和恩根两地同时交战，属第二次反法同盟战争。恩根方向陷入僵持，法军勒古布部却夺下奥军主要补给基地施托卡赫，迫使克雷下令全线撤退。此役为法军随后控制南德意志打开了通路。
summary.en: On 3 May 1800, during the War of the Second Coalition, Moreau's French army fought Kray's Austrians at Engen and Stockach. The fighting at Engen stalled, but Claude Lecourbe's troops seized Stockach, the main Austrian supply base, forcing Kray to retreat and opening southern Germany to the French.

significance.zh: 施托卡赫-恩根之战迫使奥军退出南德意志，为法军在1800年战局中的主动权奠定基础。
significance.en: Stockach-Engen pushed the Austrians out of southern Germany and gave the French the initiative in the 1800 campaign.

title.zh: 阮朝以顺化为统一越南的都城
title.en: Huế becomes the capital of Nguyễn Vietnam

summary.zh: 阮福映结束长期战争后建立阮朝，以嘉隆为年号，并将顺化确立为统一越南的首都。皇城、陵寝、庙宇和行政设施沿香江及周边地区发展，空间布局体现王权、礼制与自然景观的结合。宫廷音乐、文学和工艺在这里汇集，使顺化持续承担越南的政治、宗教与文化中心功能。
summary.en: After prolonged warfare, Nguyễn Ánh founded the Nguyễn dynasty as Gia Long and established Huế as the capital of unified Vietnam. Citadels, tombs, temples and administrative buildings developed around the Perfume River, connecting royal authority, ritual and landscape. Court music, literature and crafts flourished as Huế became a political, religious and cultural centre.

significance.zh: 顺化的建设把国家统一与阮朝宫廷文化凝聚为持久的城市遗产。
significance.en: Huế embodied political unification and Nguyễn court culture in an enduring urban heritage.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Complex of Huế Monuments

summary.zh: 法国颁布《民法典》，把革命后形成的财产权、法律平等和世俗民事秩序编入较统一的法律体系。法典简化了旧制度下复杂的地方规则，并通过法国扩张与后来的法律改革影响多国。它同时强化了家庭中的男性权威，妇女在婚姻、财产和法律行为方面受到明显限制。
summary.en: France's Civil Code consolidated property rights, legal equality and secular civil institutions into a more uniform framework. It simplified the fragmented rules inherited from the old regime and influenced other countries through French expansion and later legal reforms. Within the family, however, it reinforced male authority and restricted women's marital, property and legal autonomy.

significance.zh: 成文法典传播了革命的部分法律成果，同时延续了深刻的性别等级。
significance.en: Codification spread important revolutionary legal principles while preserving pronounced gender hierarchies.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Promulgation of the Napoleonic Code

title.zh: 索科托哈里发国的形成

summary.zh: 奥斯曼·丹·福迪奥倡导宗教改革，批评豪萨统治者的税收与治理，并领导追随者投入战争。运动汇集宗教学者、牧民和其他不满群体，在一系列战役后重组多个豪萨国家。新政权通过地方埃米尔、伊斯兰法和学术网络治理广大地区，成为十九世纪西非内陆重要的宗教政治力量。
summary.en: Usman dan Fodio criticized the taxation and government of Hausa rulers and led a movement for Islamic reform into war. Scholars, pastoralists and other dissatisfied groups joined the struggle, which reorganized several Hausa states. The resulting caliphate governed through regional emirs, Islamic law and scholarly networks and became a major nineteenth-century West African power.

significance.zh: 索科托的形成把宗教改革与区域国家重组结合，对西非思想和制度留下长期影响。
significance.en: Sokoto connected religious reform with regional state formation and left an enduring institutional and intellectual legacy.

sources.title: Library of Congress Country Study — Usman dan Fodio and the Sokoto Caliphate

summary.zh: 1805年12月2日，拿破仑一世率法国大军团在摩拉维亚的奥斯特里茨附近，击败俄国沙皇亚历山大一世与奥地利皇帝弗朗茨二世统率的俄奥联军。法军故意放弃普拉岑高地，诱使联军拉长左翼，随后中央突破并切断其退路。第三次反法同盟随之瓦解，奥地利签订《普雷斯堡和约》。
summary.en: On 2 December 1805 Napoleon's Grande Armee defeated a larger Russo-Austrian army under Tsar Alexander I and Emperor Francis II near Austerlitz in Moravia. Napoleon gave up the Pratzen heights to stretch the allied left, then broke the allied centre and cut its retreat. The Third Coalition collapsed and Austria signed the Treaty of Pressburg.

significance.zh: 奥斯特里茨是拿破仑战争中最典型的机动歼灭战，直接导致第三次反法同盟解体。
significance.en: Austerlitz is the model Napoleonic battle of manoeuvre and ended the Third Coalition.

summary.zh: 1805年10月18日，马塞纳率法军在维罗纳附近强渡阿迪杰河，击退卡尔大公部将武卡索维奇所部，在东岸建立桥头堡。此役属第三次反法同盟战争，法军的目的是牵制意大利境内的奥军，配合拿破仑在德意志的作战，也为随后10月底的卡尔迪耶罗之战创造了条件。
summary.en: On 18 October 1805 Massena's French troops crossed the Adige near Verona, drove back the Austrian defenders under Vukassovich and established a bridgehead on the east bank. The action was part of the War of the Third Coalition and was meant to pin Archduke Charles's army in Italy while Napoleon campaigned in Germany.

significance.zh: 维罗纳之战为法军在阿迪杰河东岸取得桥头堡，实现了牵制意大利战场奥军的战略目的。
significance.en: Verona gave the French a bridgehead over the Adige and tied down the Austrian army in Italy as intended.

summary.zh: 1805年10月14日，拿破仑大军团第六军在内伊元帅指挥下强攻乌尔姆以北的埃尔兴根，击溃约翰·里施统率的奥地利军。奥军被迫退入乌尔姆，随即被法军合围，数周后投降，乌尔姆战役以法军大胜告终。此役是拿破仑当年对奥作战的关键一环。
summary.en: On 14 October 1805 Michel Ney's VI Corps stormed the Elchingen bridge north of Ulm and routed the Austrian corps of Johann Sigismund Riesch. The beaten Austrians fell back into Ulm, where Napoleon's army encircled them; the garrison surrendered weeks later, closing the Ulm campaign.

significance.zh: 埃尔兴根之战完成了对乌尔姆的合围，直接促成奥军主力投降，是拿破仑1805年对奥战争的决定性步骤之一。
significance.en: It completed the encirclement of Ulm and forced the surrender of the main Austrian army, deciding Napoleon's 1805 campaign against Austria.

summary.zh: 1805年10月30日，马塞纳元帅率法军在维罗纳以东的卡尔迪耶罗迎战卡尔大公统率的奥军，属第三次反法同盟战争。法军约三万三千人实际参战，奥军投入约四万九千人，双方激战整日，奥军守住阵地，法军未能取得决定性突破，随后因乌尔姆战局变化而撤退。
summary.en: On 30 October 1805, during the War of the Third Coalition, Massena's French army attacked Archduke Charles's Austrians at Caldiero, fifteen kilometres east of Verona. About 33,000 French faced some 49,000 Austrians; the fighting lasted a full day without a decisive result before the French withdrew as the Ulm campaign closed.

significance.zh: 卡尔迪耶罗之战是1805年意大利战场规模最大的交战，牵制了卡尔大公统率的奥军主力。
significance.en: Caldiero was the largest engagement of the 1805 Italian campaign and kept Archduke Charles's main Austrian army occupied.

title.zh: 英国废除跨大西洋奴隶贸易

summary.zh: 英国议会通过法律，禁止英国臣民参与奴隶贸易。长期的废奴动员、被奴役者抵抗和政治变化共同促成决定，海军随后参与拦截运奴船。种植园中的奴隶制仍继续存在，其他国家和非法商人也维持贩运，废除贸易因而成为更长久的解放斗争与国际执法过程的一环。
summary.en: Britain's Parliament prohibited British subjects from participating in the slave trade after sustained abolitionist campaigning, resistance by enslaved people and political change. Naval interception became part of enforcement. Plantation slavery continued, alongside trafficking by other countries and illegal traders, making abolition of the trade one stage in a longer struggle over emancipation and international enforcement.

significance.zh: 禁运法改变了英国的大西洋政策，并扩大了跨国废奴运动的影响。
significance.en: The act redirected British Atlantic policy and strengthened the international abolitionist movement.

sources.title: UK Parliament — Abolition of the slave trade

summary.zh: 拿破仑战争削弱伊比利亚王权后，西属美洲多地建立自治机构，并逐步转向独立。玻利瓦尔、圣马丁等人的军队与各地社会力量参与长期战争，帝国原有的政治空间被重组为多个国家。独立后的宪政、土地与种族关系仍充满冲突，殖民时代的社会等级在新秩序中继续受到挑战。
summary.en: The Napoleonic disruption of Iberian monarchy encouraged autonomous governments and independence movements across Spanish America. Armies led by Bolívar, San Martín and others joined diverse local forces in prolonged wars that replaced imperial territories with new states. Independence was followed by disputes over constitutions, land and racial hierarchies inherited from colonial society.

significance.zh: 拉丁美洲独立重绘了美洲政治地图，并开启长期的共和国建设。
significance.en: Latin American independence redrew the continent's political map and began prolonged processes of republican state-building.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Spanish American independence wars

summary.zh: 1811年11月7日，印第安纳领地总督威廉·亨利·哈里森率美军在蒂珀卡努河附近遭滕斯克瓦塔瓦领导的部落联盟夜袭，双方激战后部落武装撤退。美军随后焚毁先知镇，特库姆塞的联盟受到重创，但土地冲突反而加速，最终导向1812年战争。
summary.en: On 7 November 1811 US forces under Indiana governor William Henry Harrison were attacked at dawn near the Tippecanoe river by Tenskwatawa's tribal confederacy. After heavy fighting the warriors withdrew and the Americans burned Prophetstown. Tecumseh's confederacy was weakened, but the land conflict deepened and led towards the War of 1812.

significance.zh: 蒂珀卡努之战摧毁了先知镇，也把美国与西北部原住民部落的冲突推向1812年战争。
significance.en: Tippecanoe destroyed Prophetstown and pushed the conflict between the United States and the northwestern tribes towards the War of 1812.

summary.zh: 1812年10月13日，美军少将范伦塞拉尔率正规军与纽约民兵从刘易斯顿渡过尼亚加拉河，进攻上加拿大的昆士顿高地。英军少将布洛克在反击中阵亡，谢弗接任指挥后击退美军，对岸民兵拒绝渡河支援，美军残部投降。这是1812年战争首场主要会战。
summary.en: On 13 October 1812 General Stephen Van Rensselaer crossed the Niagara from Lewiston with US regulars and New York militia to attack Queenston Heights in Upper Canada. British Major General Isaac Brock was killed counter-attacking, Roger Hale Sheaffe took command and broke the Americans, and the militia across the river refused to cross. It was the war's first major battle.

significance.zh: 昆士顿高地之战以英军决定性胜利告终，也因布洛克阵亡成为加拿大方面纪念的战役。
significance.en: Queenston Heights was a decisive British victory and is remembered in Canada for the death of Isaac Brock.

summary.zh: 拿破仑战败前后，欧洲列强在维也纳协商战后安排，调整疆域并恢复或确认多个王朝的地位。奥地利、英国、俄国、普鲁士和法国通过谈判寻求力量平衡，以抑制新的大规模战争。会议体系为后续外交协调提供框架，同时也同自由主义、民族主义和地方政治诉求不断发生冲突。
summary.en: European powers met in Vienna around Napoleon's defeat to negotiate territorial settlements and restore or confirm dynastic rule. Austria, Britain, Russia, Prussia and France sought a balance of power that could prevent renewed continental war. The resulting framework supported diplomatic consultation while repeatedly conflicting with liberal, nationalist and local political aspirations.

significance.zh: 维也纳安排塑造了十九世纪欧洲外交与反革命政治的基本格局。
significance.en: The Vienna settlement shaped nineteenth-century European diplomacy and conservative political order.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Congress of Vienna

summary.zh: 印度尼西亚松巴哇岛的坦博拉火山猛烈喷发，火山灰和碎屑摧毁周边聚落，造成大规模伤亡与流离。进入高层大气的物质影响全球气候，次年部分地区出现异常寒冷和收成失败。灾害通过粮食价格、饥荒与迁徙产生跨洲影响，显示偏远地区的地质活动也能改变全球社会生活。
summary.en: Tambora's eruption on Sumbawa devastated nearby settlements with ash and volcanic debris, causing extensive deaths and displacement. Material injected into the upper atmosphere affected global climate, contributing to unusual cold and crop failures in several regions the following year. Food shortages, rising prices and migration transmitted the disaster's consequences across continents.

significance.zh: 坦博拉把局部火山灾害与全球气候、农业和社会危机联系在一起。
significance.en: Tambora connected a volcanic catastrophe with global climatic, agricultural and social disruption.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Eruption of Mount Tambora

summary.zh: 1815年1月，安德鲁·杰克逊率美军在路易斯安那的新奥尔良附近击退英军进攻，英军指挥官阵亡，伤亡远高于美军。战斗发生于《根特条约》签署之后、消息传到北美之前，因此对战后的领土安排没有影响，却使杰克逊成为全国性政治人物，也掩盖了战争已经结束的事实。
summary.en: In January 1815 Andrew Jackson's American force repelled a British attack near New Orleans; the British commander was killed and British losses far exceeded American ones. It was fought after the Treaty of Ghent had been signed but before news reached North America, so it changed no territory, yet it made Jackson a national political figure.

significance.zh: 新奥尔良之战虽未改变条约结果，却强化了美国对路易斯安那的主权声索与民族叙事。
significance.en: New Orleans changed no treaty terms but strengthened American claims and national memory in Louisiana.

title.zh: 莱武卡与十九世纪太平洋港镇
title.en: Levuka and the nineteenth-century Pacific port town

summary.zh: 十九世纪二十年代起，斐济的莱武卡因海滩交易、椰油和贸易船而发展成港镇。欧洲商人、传教士与斐济社群在此交汇，木构商铺、仓库、教堂与行政建筑沿滨海形成低层街区。1874年斐济成为英国殖民地后，莱武卡一度作为首府；1882年首府迁往苏瓦，港镇的发展随之放缓。
summary.en: From the 1820s Levuka grew into a port town in Fiji through beachcomber trade, coconut oil and shipping. European traders, missionaries and Fijian communities met there, and low-rise wooden shops, warehouses, churches and administrative buildings lined the shore. After Fiji became a British colony in 1874 Levuka briefly served as capital; the capital moved to Suva in 1882 and growth slowed.

significance.zh: 莱武卡展示了太平洋岛屿港镇在殖民接触时期的空间与社会形态。
significance.en: Levuka shows the spatial and social form of a Pacific island port town during colonial contact.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Levuka Historical Port Town

editorialNotes.zh: 1820年代为港镇发展阶段起点，不能据此推断当地村落形成于此时；1874与1882年的政治变化分别表述。
editorialNotes.en: The 1820s mark the beginning of the port-town phase and do not imply that local villages began then; the political changes of 1874 and 1882 are kept separate.

summary.zh: 教会传教会在弗里敦创办福拉湾学院，最初主要培养教师与传教人员。学校随着课程与学位制度的发展，吸引西非不同地区的学生，并于十九世纪后期同英国杜伦大学建立联系。毕业生进入教育、宗教和公共生活，使学院成为区域知识传播和专业人才培养的重要机构。
summary.en: The Church Missionary Society founded Fourah Bay College in Freetown to train teachers and missionaries. Expanding curricula and later university affiliation attracted students from different parts of West Africa. Graduates entered education, religious institutions and public life, helping the college become a significant regional centre for learning and professional training.

significance.zh: 学院推动了近代西非高等教育网络的发展，并扩大非洲知识分子的交流空间。
significance.en: The college helped develop modern West African higher education and networks of African intellectual exchange.

summary.zh: 东印度公司治下的孟加拉颁布法令，禁止寡妇在丈夫火葬时殉葬，并将协助或参与实施者纳入刑事惩处。拉姆·莫汉·罗伊等印度改革者长期反对这一习俗，宗教解释、妇女处境与殖民干预在争论中交织。法令推动法律与社会改革，也使国家权力介入宗教惯例的问题更加突出。
summary.en: Bengal's colonial government prohibited sati, the burning of widows on their husbands' funeral pyres, and made participation punishable. Indian reformers including Ram Mohan Roy had campaigned against the practice. Debates intertwined religious interpretation, women's circumstances and colonial intervention, making the regulation a significant episode in legal and social reform.

significance.zh: 禁令成为南亚妇女处境、社会改革与宗教权威讨论的重要节点。
significance.en: The prohibition became an important point in South Asian debates over women, reform and religious authority.

sources.title: Fordham University Internet History Sourcebook — Bentinck on the suppression of sati, 1829

summary.zh: 法国军队在阿尔及尔附近登陆并夺取城市，开启对阿尔及利亚的长期征服。阿卜杜·卡迪尔等领导的抵抗迫使法军持续作战，战争伴随土地没收、强制迁移与平民苦难。殖民者定居和行政制度随后扩大，改变了土地关系与社会结构，也积累了二十世纪民族解放运动面对的矛盾。
summary.en: French forces landed near Algiers and captured the city, beginning a prolonged conquest of Algeria. Resistance led by Abd al-Qadir and others was met with sustained warfare, land confiscation and forced displacement. Settler colonization and administrative expansion transformed landholding and society, establishing conditions that later shaped the national liberation struggle.

significance.zh: 入侵开启了法国在北非最持久、冲突最深的殖民统治之一。
significance.en: The invasion began one of France's most enduring and deeply contested colonial regimes.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — French invasion of Algeria

title.zh: 大博弈与中亚边界的划定
title.en: The Great Game and the making of Central Asian borders

summary.zh: 19世纪，英国与俄罗斯帝国围绕中亚、阿富汗、波斯与西藏的影响力展开长期竞争，史称“大博弈”。俄罗斯征服突厥斯坦，英国扩张并划定英属印度边界，双方通过军事干预与外交谈判重新界定领土；到20世纪初，两国之间形成一条由独立或半独立政权、部落与君主国构成的缓冲带。
summary.en: In the nineteenth century Britain and the Russian Empire competed for influence across Central Asia, Afghanistan, Persia and Tibet in what became known as the Great Game. Russia conquered Turkestan while Britain expanded and defined the borders of British India, and military intervention and diplomacy redrew territory, leaving by the early twentieth century a buffer of independent or semi-independent states, tribes and monarchies.

significance.zh: 大博弈塑造了中亚与南亚的现代边界，其影响延续到当代地缘政治。
significance.en: The Great Game shaped modern Central and South Asian borders with effects that persist in contemporary geopolitics.

sources.title: Wikipedia — The Great Game（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: “大博弈”是后世概括的术语，时间范围并无统一界定；本条用约1830—1895年表示竞争最激烈的阶段。
editorialNotes.en: The term is a later label without a single agreed span; the c. 1830–1895 range marks the most intense phase of rivalry.

title.en: Slavery Abolition Act in the British Empire

summary.zh: 英国议会通过《废除奴隶制法》，为帝国多数殖民地的法律废奴建立依据，主要条款于次年实施。许多获释者仍被迫进入所谓学徒制度，种植园的劳动关系继续引发抗争。殖民地奴隶主获得巨额国家补偿，而被奴役者争取土地、工资和真正自由的斗争则延续下去。
summary.en: Britain's Slavery Abolition Act established emancipation in most British colonies, with its main provisions taking effect the following year. Many formerly enslaved people were compelled into apprenticeship arrangements, and plantation labour remained contested. Slaveholders received substantial government compensation, while freed communities continued struggles over land, wages and the practical meaning of freedom.

significance.zh: 法律废奴改变了殖民社会的劳动制度，并开启新的自由与平等斗争。
significance.en: Legal emancipation transformed colonial labour systems and opened further struggles over freedom and equality.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Slavery Abolition Act in the British Empire

title.zh: 毛里求斯契约劳工移民制度扩展

summary.zh: 英国废奴后，在毛里求斯推动以契约劳工维持种植园生产，印度移民开始大规模跨海进入糖业劳动体系。招募、运输与多年合同把家庭生计同殖民市场联系起来，劳工经常面对严厉纪律和有限选择。此后制度扩散至其他殖民地，迁徙人口也逐渐改变毛里求斯及印度洋地区的文化与社会构成。
summary.en: After abolition, British authorities promoted indentured labour in Mauritius to sustain plantation production. Indian migrants entered sugar work through recruitment, overseas transport and multi-year contracts, often under strict discipline and constrained choices. The system spread to other colonies, while migrant families reshaped the social and cultural composition of Mauritius and the wider Indian Ocean.

significance.zh: 契约移民把后奴隶制劳动体系与全球人口流动连接起来，形成新的跨国侨民社会。
significance.en: Indenture linked post-emancipation labour systems with global migration and new diasporic communities.

sources.title: UNESCO World Heritage Centre — Aapravasi Ghat

editorialNotes.zh: 1834年标示毛里求斯契约劳工移民试验的开端；今天列入世界遗产的阿普拉瓦西·加特移民站主体建于1849年。
editorialNotes.en: 1834 marks the beginning of the Mauritian indentured-migration experiment; the Aapravasi Ghat immigration depot now on the World Heritage List was built in 1849.

summary.zh: 第一次英阿战争（1838—1842）是英国与锡克帝国支持杜兰尼系的舒贾沙阿、对抗喀布尔与坎大哈的巴拉克扎伊王朝的战争，也是“大博弈”初期的重要冲突。英军1839年占领喀布尔并扶植舒贾沙阿，但1841至1842年遭到全面反抗，撤退中损失惨重，最终放弃长期占领。
summary.en: The First Anglo-Afghan War (1838–1842) was fought by Britain and the Sikh Empire in support of the Durrani claimant Shuja Shah against the Barakzai rulers of Kabul and Kandahar, an early major conflict of the Great Game. British forces occupied Kabul in 1839 and restored Shuja Shah, but a general uprising in 1841–42 led to a disastrous retreat and the abandonment of lasting occupation.

significance.zh: 这场战争暴露了外来军队在阿富汗维持占领的困难，成为19世纪帝国竞争的典型案例。
significance.en: The war exposed the difficulty foreign armies faced in holding Afghanistan and became a classic case of nineteenth-century imperial rivalry.

sources.title: Wikipedia — First Anglo-Afghan War（CC BY-SA 4.0，2026-10-03 本会话读取）

editorialNotes.zh: 战争起止为1838—1842年；伤亡与撤退细节在不同史料中的数字差异很大，本条不作具体人数陈述。
editorialNotes.en: The war is dated 1838–1842; casualty and retreat figures vary widely between sources, so no specific numbers are given.

summary.zh: 清政府查禁鸦片贸易后，英国以武力干预，战争在中国沿海与长江下游展开。清军在海军技术、组织和后勤方面处于不利地位，最终签订《南京条约》。香港割让、赔款和通商口岸开放改变了中外关系，条约体系随后继续扩大，清朝也逐渐面对改革外交与军事制度的压力。
summary.en: Britain intervened militarily after Qing efforts to suppress the opium trade, fighting along China's coast and lower Yangtze. Qing forces faced disadvantages in naval technology, organization and logistics. The Treaty of Nanjing ceded Hong Kong, imposed an indemnity and opened treaty ports, initiating a widening treaty system and pressure for institutional reform.

significance.zh: 战争使清朝进入不平等条约体系，并深刻改变中国与海外势力的关系。
significance.en: The war drew Qing China into an unequal treaty system and transformed its foreign relations.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — First Opium War

title.en: Signing of the Treaty of Waitangi

summary.zh: 英国代表与毛利首领开始签署《怀唐伊条约》，随后签名活动在新西兰多地继续。毛利文和英文文本对统治权、主权与酋长权威的表述存在重要差异，影响了双方的理解。殖民扩张、土地交易和战争不断加深争议，条约后来又成为毛利权利主张、历史申诉与国家关系的重要基础。
summary.en: British representatives and Māori chiefs began signing the Treaty of Waitangi, with signatures subsequently collected around New Zealand. Differences between Māori and English texts concerning governance, sovereignty and chiefly authority shaped divergent understandings. Colonization, land transactions and warfare intensified disputes, while the treaty later became central to Māori rights claims and historical settlements.

significance.zh: 条约及其不同文本持续影响新西兰国家权力与毛利权利的讨论。
significance.en: The treaty and its differing texts remain central to debates over state authority and Māori rights.

sources.title: NZHistory — Treaty of Waitangi

summary.zh: 1844年8月14日，法国元帅比若率军在摩洛哥伊斯利河畔击败苏丹阿卜杜勒-拉赫曼之子穆罕默德王子统率的摩洛哥军队。法国意在迫使摩洛哥停止支持阿尔及利亚抵抗领袖阿卜杜·卡迪尔，战前并未宣战。战后双方签约，摩洛哥承诺放弃对卡迪尔的支持。
summary.en: On 14 August 1844 French forces under Marshal Bugeaud routed a larger but poorly organised Moroccan army commanded by Muhammad, son of Sultan Abd al-Rahman, near the Isly River. France acted without a declaration of war to end Moroccan support for the Algerian resistance leader Abd el-Kader, and the defeat forced Morocco to negotiate.

significance.zh: 伊斯利之战迫使摩洛哥放弃对阿卜杜·卡迪尔的支持，加速了法国对阿尔及利亚的征服，并确立了法摩之间的不平等关系。
significance.en: The battle forced Morocco to drop Abd el-Kader, accelerated the French conquest of Algeria and set the terms of French dominance over Morocco.

summary.zh: 经济困难、粮食危机和政治排斥推动欧洲多地爆发革命，巴黎、维也纳、柏林及意大利地区相继出现动员。参与者要求宪法、代议制度、民族统一或社会改革，工人与中产阶层之间也存在分歧。多数革命政府最终被压制，但农奴义务、政治组织与民族国家议题已经发生持久变化。
summary.en: Economic hardship, food crises and political exclusion helped provoke revolutions across Europe, including Paris, Vienna, Berlin and Italian territories. Participants demanded constitutions, representation, national unification or social reform, while workers and middle-class reformers often disagreed. Most revolutionary governments were defeated, but changes to rural obligations and political mobilization endured.

significance.zh: 革命虽多遭挫败，却扩大了公民政治与民族运动的社会基础。
significance.en: Despite defeat, the revolutions widened the social foundations of civic politics and national movements.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — European revolutions of 1848

summary.zh: 洪秀全领导的太平天国运动在华南兴起，逐渐占领长江流域大片地区，并以南京为天京。其宗教思想、土地主张和政治组织挑战清朝统治，战争又引发地方军事力量的扩张。清军与地方武装经过长期围剿攻陷天京，冲突、饥荒和疫病造成巨大人口损失，帝国权力结构也随之改变。
summary.en: Hong Xiuquan's Taiping movement arose in southern China, occupied extensive Yangtze territories and made Nanjing its capital. Its religious teachings, land proposals and political organization challenged Qing rule, while war strengthened regional military forces. Qing and local armies eventually captured the capital after a conflict whose fighting, famine and disease caused immense human losses.

significance.zh: 太平天国战争重创清代社会，并推动军事与地方权力结构的变化。
significance.en: The Taiping war devastated Qing society and altered the balance of military and regional power.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Taiping Rebellion

summary.zh: 俄国与奥斯曼帝国的争端升级为战争，英国、法国和撒丁王国随后站到奥斯曼一方。克里米亚半岛的围城与战斗造成严重损失，疾病和供应问题进一步暴露军队管理缺陷。新闻报道、摄影和护理改革让战争进入新的公共视野，战后俄国也加紧反思军事、交通与社会制度。
summary.en: Conflict between Russia and the Ottoman Empire drew in Britain, France and Sardinia on the Ottoman side. Fighting and siege warfare in Crimea caused heavy losses, compounded by disease and poor supply. Reporting, photography and nursing reform brought the war into public view, while Russia's defeat increased pressure for military, transport and social reform.

significance.zh: 战争动摇了欧洲旧有均势，并促进现代战争报道与军队医疗改革。
significance.en: The conflict unsettled Europe's balance of power and advanced war reporting and military medical reform.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Crimean War

title.en: Foundation of the University of Calcutta

summary.zh: 加尔各答大学依据殖民政府推动的高等教育计划成立，初期以伦敦大学为制度参照，组织考试、学位和附属学院体系。新的教育网络培养法律、行政、科学与文学人才，也为印度知识分子交流提供平台。随着学科与研究扩展，大学逐渐参与社会改革、科学创造和民族政治的公共讨论。
summary.en: The University of Calcutta was established under a colonial higher-education programme, initially following the University of London's examining and affiliation model. Its network trained professionals in administration, law, science and literature and created spaces for Indian intellectual exchange. Expanding disciplines and research later connected the university with social reform, scientific work and national politics.

significance.zh: 大学推动了南亚现代高等教育制度与跨学科知识网络的发展。
significance.en: The university helped develop modern South Asian higher education and interdisciplinary intellectual networks.

sources.title: University of Calcutta — Foundation of the University

title.zh: 印度起义与公司统治终结
title.en: Indian Rebellion and the end of company rule

summary.zh: 印度士兵的兵变与地方社会对东印度公司统治的不满汇合，在北印度和中印度发展为广泛起义。各地参与者追求不同目标，既包括恢复旧权利，也包括反抗侵占和社会干预。英国镇压起义后，议会取消公司的统治权，由王室直接管理印度，并重新调整军队、土邦关系和殖民政策。
summary.en: A sepoy revolt combined with broader grievances against East India Company rule to produce uprisings across northern and central India. Participants pursued diverse aims, including restoration of rights and resistance to annexation and interference. After suppression, Britain transferred authority from the company to the Crown and reorganized the army, princely relations and colonial policy.

significance.zh: 起义终结了公司的直接统治，使英国在印度的殖民制度发生转型。
significance.en: The uprising ended direct company rule and transformed Britain's colonial institutions in India.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Indian Rebellion and the end of company rule

title.en: Publication of On the Origin of Species

summary.zh: 达尔文出版《物种起源》，综合自然观察、育种研究和长期通信，以自然选择解释生物适应与物种变化。华莱士此前独立提出相近思想，两人的论文曾共同发表。著作引发广泛科学与宗教讨论，进化研究随后同遗传学、生态学和化石证据结合，持续修正并扩展对生命历史的理解。
summary.en: Darwin's On the Origin of Species synthesized observations, breeding studies and correspondence to explain adaptation and evolutionary change through natural selection. Wallace had independently reached a similar idea, and their papers had been presented jointly. The book generated wide debate, while later genetics, ecology and fossil research expanded and refined evolutionary understanding.

significance.zh: 自然选择为解释生命多样性提供了能够检验和持续发展的机制。
significance.en: Natural selection offered a testable mechanism for explaining biological diversity and change.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Publication of On the Origin of Species

summary.zh: 1860年9月21日，第二次鸦片战争期间，僧格林沁统率的清军主力——蒙古骑兵与京畿八旗绿营——在通州八里桥迎战英法联军。联军凭借线膛枪炮击溃清军骑兵，僧格林沁部损失惨重。咸丰帝随即逃往承德，联军进逼北京，清朝被迫签订《北京条约》。
summary.en: On 21 September 1860, during the Second Opium War, Qing forces under Sengge Rinchen, mainly Mongol cavalry and Beijing garrison troops, met the Anglo-French army at Baliqiao near Tongzhou. Rifled artillery broke the cavalry; the emperor fled to Chengde, the allies entered Beijing and the Qing court signed the Convention of Beijing.

significance.zh: 八里桥之战摧毁了清军最精锐的骑兵主力，为英法联军攻入北京、迫使清朝签订《北京条约》扫清了道路。
significance.en: The destruction of the Qing cavalry opened Beijing to the Anglo-French force and forced the treaty that ended the Second Opium War.

summary.zh: 亚历山大二世颁布农奴解放改革，结束私人庄园中大量农奴对地主的人身依附。农民获得法律身份与一定土地权利，但土地分配、赎买费用和村社安排仍限制生活改善。改革推动劳动力与市场关系变化，也留下土地不足和贫困问题，成为此后俄国政治争论与农村动荡的重要背景。
summary.en: Alexander II's emancipation reform ended personal bondage for millions of serfs on private estates. Peasants acquired legal standing and certain land rights, but allotments, redemption payments and communal arrangements constrained the benefits. The reform changed labour and market relationships while leaving land shortages and poverty that continued to shape Russian politics and rural unrest.

significance.zh: 农奴解放改变了帝国的社会基础，土地问题则继续推动后续改革与革命。
significance.en: Emancipation changed the empire's social foundations, while unresolved land questions drove later reform and revolution.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Emancipation of Russian serfs

title.zh: 美国内战与奴隶制废除
title.en: American Civil War and abolition of slavery

summary.zh: 奴隶制的扩张与存续引发日益激烈的政治冲突，南方各州脱离联邦后爆发内战。联邦军最终获胜，战争中的解放政策、被奴役者自我解放和黑人参军共同推动奴隶制瓦解。第十三修正案完成法律废奴，重建时期随后围绕公民身份、投票权和种族权力展开激烈斗争。
summary.en: Conflict over slavery's expansion and survival led southern states to secede and triggered civil war. Union victory, wartime emancipation policies, enslaved people's pursuit of freedom and Black military service together dismantled slavery. The Thirteenth Amendment established legal abolition, and Reconstruction brought further struggles over citizenship, voting rights and racial power.

significance.zh: 内战维护了联邦并废除奴隶制，重新界定了美国自由与公民权的政治议程。
significance.en: The war preserved the Union, abolished slavery and recast the political struggle over freedom and citizenship.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — American Civil War and abolition of slavery

title.zh: 红十字运动与第一部日内瓦公约
title.en: Red Cross movement and the first Geneva Convention

summary.zh: 索尔费里诺战场伤员的遭遇促使亨利·杜南倡议建立救援组织，日内瓦的委员会随后推动国际合作。各国于次年通过首部《日内瓦公约》，要求照顾伤员并保护医疗人员与设施。志愿救护、统一标志和国际条约相结合，成为红十字运动与现代战争人道规则的制度起点。
summary.en: The suffering of wounded soldiers at Solferino led Henry Dunant to advocate organized relief, and a Geneva committee promoted international cooperation. The first Geneva Convention followed in 1864, requiring care for wounded soldiers and protection for medical personnel and facilities. Volunteer relief, a recognized emblem and treaty obligations established foundations for the Red Cross movement.

significance.zh: 救援组织与国际公约开始共同承担减轻战争苦难的责任。
significance.en: Organized relief and international treaty obligations became complementary means of reducing wartime suffering.

sources.title: ICRC — Founding and early years

summary.zh: 反幕府力量宣布恢复天皇统治，德川政权在政治重组与戊辰战争中瓦解。新政府随后推进废藩置县、征兵、学校教育和工业建设，逐渐把藩国分立的秩序改造为中央集权国家。改革改变了武士身份、税制和日常生活，也增强日本参与国际竞争及对外扩张的能力。
summary.en: Anti-shogunal forces proclaimed the restoration of imperial rule, and Tokugawa government collapsed through political realignment and the Boshin War. The new state abolished domains, introduced conscription, expanded schooling and promoted industry. These changes centralized government, transformed samurai status and taxation, and strengthened Japan's capacity for international competition and imperial expansion.

significance.zh: 明治改革重建了日本的国家制度，并加速其工业化与社会转型。
significance.en: Meiji reforms rebuilt Japan's state institutions and accelerated industrial and social transformation.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Meiji Restoration

summary.zh: 1868年1月27日至30日，支持明治天皇的新政府军与德川幕府军在京都南郊的鸟羽、伏见一带交战。政府军以萨摩、长州、土佐等藩兵为主，击退幕府军并迫使其退往大阪。此役是戊辰战争的开端，也是幕府权威迅速崩解的标志，德川庆喜随后从大阪撤回江户。
summary.en: From 27 to 30 January 1868 the forces of the new Meiji government and the Tokugawa shogunate fought at Toba and Fushimi south of Kyoto. Satsuma, Choshu and Tosa troops repulsed the shogunate army and drove it back towards Osaka. The battle opened the Boshin War and marked the rapid collapse of shogunate authority.

significance.zh: 鸟羽伏见之战使新政府掌握军事主动，随后以官军名义推进，戊辰战争由此展开。
significance.en: Toba-Fushimi gave the new government the initiative as the imperial army and began the Boshin War.

summary.zh: 苏伊士运河正式通航，在地中海与红海之间开辟直接航道，缩短欧洲与亚洲间多条海运路线。工程依靠大规模劳动力和国际资本，其融资又与埃及债务及欧洲干预相连。运河把全球航运集中到新的战略通道，埃及由此成为商业、军事和国家主权竞争的关键地区。
summary.en: The Suez Canal opened a direct passage between the Mediterranean and Red Sea, shortening many shipping routes between Europe and Asia. Construction drew on extensive labour and international capital, while financing became entangled with Egyptian debt and European intervention. The canal concentrated commerce along a new strategic corridor contested by states and empires.

significance.zh: 新航道重组了全球海运，也显著提高了埃及的战略地位。
significance.en: The canal reorganized world shipping and greatly increased Egypt's strategic importance.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Opening of the Suez Canal

summary.zh: 普鲁士在同丹麦、奥地利及法国的战争和外交竞争中扩大影响，最终推动多数德意志邦国统一。威廉一世在凡尔赛被宣布为德意志皇帝，新帝国保留联邦结构，却由普鲁士掌握主导地位。统一带来庞大的国内市场与强大工业国家，也使欧洲原有的力量平衡发生深刻变化。
summary.en: Prussia expanded its influence through wars and diplomacy involving Denmark, Austria and France, bringing most German states into a new empire. Wilhelm I was proclaimed emperor at Versailles. The empire retained a federal structure under Prussian predominance, combining a large internal market with industrial power and substantially altering Europe's balance of power.

significance.zh: 德国统一使一个新的工业与军事强国成为欧洲政治中心力量。
significance.en: Unification placed a new industrial and military power at the centre of European politics.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Proclamation of the German Empire

title.zh: 贝尔取得电话专利并传输语音
title.en: Bell’s telephone patent and voice transmission

summary.zh: 亚历山大·格雷厄姆·贝尔取得电话相关专利，并实现清晰语音的电传输。围绕电信技术已有多位发明者长期实验，电话随后通过交换台、线路建设和商业运营进入日常生活。实时远距离通话改变了企业组织、城市联系与私人交流，也使通信网络的投资和控制成为新的经济问题。
summary.en: Alexander Graham Bell obtained a telephone patent and demonstrated intelligible speech transmitted electrically. Building on experiments by several inventors, telephone service spread through exchanges, line construction and commercial operation. Real-time conversation over distance changed business organization, urban connections and personal communication, while network investment and control acquired growing economic importance.

significance.zh: 电话使远距离交流从文字电报扩展到即时语音，推动现代通信网络形成。
significance.en: The telephone extended long-distance communication into live speech and helped build modern communications networks.

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica — Bell’s telephone patent and voice transmission

summary.zh: 1877年9月24日，日本西南战争的最后一战在鹿儿岛城山展开。西乡隆盛率残余萨摩藩士据守城山，遭山县有朋指挥的政府军包围。政府军以炮击与优势兵力发起总攻，萨军抵抗数小时后被歼灭，西乡隆盛阵亡。武士阶级主导的叛乱至此终结。
summary.en: On 24 September 1877 the last battle of the Satsuma Rebellion was fought at Shiroyama in Kagoshima. Saigo Takamori's remaining samurai, besieged by government troops under Yamagata Aritomo, were attacked with artillery and overwhelming numbers and destroyed within hours; Saigo died. Armed resistance by the samurai class ended.

significance.zh: 城山之战终结了西南战争，也标志着明治政府完成对武士阶层武装反抗的镇压。
significance.en: Shiroyama ended the Satsuma Rebellion and completed the Meiji government's suppression of samurai armed resistance.

summary.zh: 1877年11月17日夜，俄军在高加索战场攻取奥斯曼帝国重镇卡尔斯。此前俄军7月的围攻被击退，此番改由洛里斯-梅利科夫指挥，先夺取东部防御工事，再切断侯赛因帕夏守军的退路，大批奥斯曼官兵被俘。战后签订的条约使卡尔斯割让给俄国，直到1921年才归还土耳其。
summary.en: On the night of 17 November 1877 Russian forces in the Caucasus stormed Kars, the key Ottoman fortress that had repelled their siege in July. Under Loris-Melikov the Russians seized the eastern works and cut off Hussein Pasha's garrison, capturing most of it. The later treaty ceded Kars to Russia, which held the city until 1921.

significance.zh: 卡尔斯之战是1877年至1878年俄土战争高加索战场的决定性胜利，直接导致卡尔斯被割让给俄国。
significance.en: Kars decided the Caucasus theatre of the Russo-Turkish War of 1877-1878 and led directly to the cession of the city to Russia.

summary.zh: 1879年3月29日，祖鲁战争期间，祖鲁军队在坎布拉攻击英军营地，此前一天他们刚击溃英军骑马部队。英军已构筑车阵与工事，以密集火力击退祖鲁军的反复冲击，祖鲁方面阵亡约两千人，英军损失二十九人。祖鲁王国此后再无进攻能力，战争胜负就此逆转。
summary.en: On 29 March 1879, during the Anglo-Zulu War, a Zulu army attacked the British camp at Kambula a day after routing its mounted patrol. The entrenched British square broke the assault with concentrated fire, killing roughly two thousand warriors for the loss of twenty-nine soldiers, and Zulu confidence never recovered.

significance.zh: 坎布拉战役是祖鲁战争的转折点，祖鲁王国主力在此战后丧失进攻能力，同年七月即告覆亡。
significance.en: It was the turning point of the Anglo-Zulu War: the Zulu army lost its offensive power and the kingdom fell that July.
